Detection And Remediation Scripts
RS-ITQ-ua-win-all-Remediate-Language-NL-NL 10 settings Intune - Pro Active Remediation
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionThis Proactive Remediation aligns the current user's language, regional, and keyboard settings with the Dutch (Netherlands) device language configuration (nl-NL). The remediation only runs when the device language remediation has successfully completed and the required remediation marker is present in the registry. This ensures that user-specific settings are applied only after the device-wide language configuration has been established. Note: This will need the user to reboot the system itself The remediation performs the following actions: Verifies that the device language remediation marker is present. Configures Dutch (Netherlands) (nl-NL) as the primary user language. Sets the user culture and regional format to Dutch (Netherlands). Configures the home location to Netherlands (GeoID 176). Configures the Dutch language profile with the US-International keyboard layout (00020409). Sets the Windows UI language override to Dutch (Netherlands). Validates that all user language and regional settings match the device configuration. Remediates only user-scoped settings and does not modify device-wide language settings. Returns success when the desired configuration is already present, making the remediation fully idempotent. Registry Dependency: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\LanguagePackDeployer\RemediationExpand
Created24/07/2026 09:44:22
Modified28/07/2026 07:19:04
ScopeTags0
Settings
SettingValue
PublisherJeffrey Bouwmeester
Detection Script Content
View script
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Detects the requested language configuration for the current Windows user.
.DESCRIPTION
    Checks device prerequisites and the current user's language, culture,
    keyboard and regional settings. Device prerequisites are read-only; when
    the required language packs are not installed device-wide yet (the
    system-context device policy has not run), the user cannot be compliant, so
    detection reports non-compliant and lets the schedule catch up rather than
    falsely reporting compliant.
.NOTES
    Product: Language Pack Deployer
    Version: 1.0.0

    Exit codes:
      0    User settings are compliant
      1    User remediation is required, device prerequisites are not ready,
           or detection failed
#>

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# <LanguagePackDeployerConfiguration>
$languages = @(
    @{ Tag = 'nl-NL'; GeoId = 176; Keyboard = '00020409'; KeyboardName = 'US-International' }
)
$primaryTag = 'nl-NL'
# </LanguagePackDeployerConfiguration>

if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432 -eq 'AMD64') {
    $sysnative = "$env:WINDIR\sysnative\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe"
    & $sysnative -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

function Get-KeyboardTip([hashtable]$language) {
    if (-not $language.Keyboard) { return $null }
    $lcidHex = '{0:x4}' -f ([System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo($language.Tag).LCID)
    return "${lcidHex}:$($language.Keyboard)"
}

try {
$markerPath = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\LanguagePackDeployer\Remediation'
$marker = Get-ItemProperty -Path $markerPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Output 'Language Pack Deployer - User detection'
Write-Output "User: $env:USERNAME"
Write-Output "Requested languages: $(($languages.Tag) -join ', ')"
Write-Output "Primary language: $primaryTag"

if (-not $marker) {
    Write-Output 'Result: Compliant - Device remediation has not been run.'
    exit 0
}

Write-Output '[PASS] Device remediation marker detected.'

$issues = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$languageList = @(Get-WinUserLanguageList)

$actualPrimaryLanguage = if ($languageList.Count -gt 0) {
    ($languageList.LanguageTag | Select-Object -First 1)
}
else {
    '(none)'
}

if ($actualPrimaryLanguage -ne $primaryTag) {
    $issues.Add("Primary user language is '$actualPrimaryLanguage'; expected '$primaryTag'")
    Write-Output "[FAIL] Primary user language: $actualPrimaryLanguage (expected: $primaryTag)"
}
else {
    Write-Output "[PASS] Primary user language: $actualPrimaryLanguage"
}


    foreach ($language in $languages) {
        $entry = $languageList | Where-Object { $_.LanguageTag -eq $language.Tag }
        if (-not $entry) {
            $issues.Add("User language is missing: $($language.Tag)")
            Write-Output "[FAIL] User language: $($language.Tag) (missing)"
        }
        else {
            Write-Output "[PASS] User language: $($language.Tag)"
        }
        $tip = Get-KeyboardTip $language
        if ($tip) {
            $keyboardDescription = if ($language.KeyboardName) { "$($language.KeyboardName) ($tip)" } else { $tip }
            if (-not $entry -or $entry.InputMethodTips -notcontains $tip) {
                $issues.Add("Keyboard layout is missing: $keyboardDescription")
                Write-Output "[FAIL] Keyboard layout: $keyboardDescription (missing)"
            }
            else {
                Write-Output "[PASS] Keyboard layout: $keyboardDescription"
            }
        }
    }

    $actualCulture = (Get-Culture).Name
    if ($actualCulture -ne $primaryTag) {
        $issues.Add("User culture is '$actualCulture'; expected '$primaryTag'")
        Write-Output "[FAIL] User culture: $actualCulture (expected: $primaryTag)"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] User culture: $actualCulture"
    }

    $primaryLanguage = $languages | Where-Object { $_.Tag -eq $primaryTag }
    $actualGeoId = (Get-WinHomeLocation).GeoId
    if ($actualGeoId -ne $primaryLanguage.GeoId) {
        $issues.Add("User home location is GeoId '$actualGeoId'; expected '$($primaryLanguage.GeoId)'")
        Write-Output "[FAIL] User home location: GeoId $actualGeoId (expected: $($primaryLanguage.GeoId))"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] User home location: GeoId $actualGeoId"
    }

    $uiOverride = Get-WinUILanguageOverride
    $actualUiOverride = if ($uiOverride) { $uiOverride.Name } else { '(not set)' }
    if ($actualUiOverride -ne $primaryTag) {
        $issues.Add("User UI language override is '$actualUiOverride'; expected '$primaryTag'")
        Write-Output "[FAIL] User UI language override: $actualUiOverride (expected: $primaryTag)"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] User UI language override: $actualUiOverride"
    }

    if ($issues.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Output "Result: Non-compliant ($($issues.Count) issue(s))"
        foreach ($issue in $issues) {
            Write-Output " - $issue"
        }
        exit 1
    }

    Write-Output 'Result: Compliant (all user checks passed)'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-Output "User language configuration detection failed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}
Remediation Script Content
View script
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Configures the requested language settings for the current Windows user.
.DESCRIPTION
    Preserves unrelated user languages while ensuring the requested languages,
    primary language, keyboard, culture, UI override and home location.
.NOTES
    Product: Language Pack Deployer
    Version: 1.0.0
    Context: Logged-on user

    The required language packs must already be installed on the device. A new
    sign-in can be required before the Windows display language changes.
#>

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# <LanguagePackDeployerConfiguration>
$languages = @(
    @{ Tag = 'nl-NL'; GeoId = 176; Keyboard = '00020409'; KeyboardName = 'US-International' }
)
$primaryTag = 'nl-NL'
# </LanguagePackDeployerConfiguration>

if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432 -eq 'AMD64') {
    $sysnative = "$env:WINDIR\sysnative\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe"
    & $sysnative -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

function Get-KeyboardTip([hashtable]$language) {
    if (-not $language.Keyboard) { return $null }
    $lcidHex = '{0:x4}' -f ([System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo($language.Tag).LCID)
    return "${lcidHex}:$($language.Keyboard)"
}

try {
    $installedTags = @((Get-InstalledLanguage).LanguageId)

    Write-Output 'Language Pack Deployer - User remediation'
    Write-Output "User: $env:USERNAME"
    Write-Output "Requested languages: $(($languages.Tag) -join ', ')"
    Write-Output "Primary language: $primaryTag"

    foreach ($language in $languages) {
        if ($installedTags -notcontains $language.Tag) {
            # Can't configure the user until the system-context device policy has
            # installed the pack. Exit 0 (ran without error, nothing to do yet) -
            # detection stays non-compliant so the schedule retries once it lands.
            Write-Output "[PENDING] Device language pack is not installed yet: $($language.Tag)"
            Write-Output 'Result: Deferred - waiting for the device (system-context) policy to install the language pack(s).'
            exit 0
        }
    }

    $languageList = Get-WinUserLanguageList
    foreach ($language in $languages) {
        if ($languageList.LanguageTag -notcontains $language.Tag) {
            $languageList.Add($language.Tag)
            Write-Output "[CHANGED] Added user language: $($language.Tag)"
        }
        else {
            Write-Output "[PASS] User language already present: $($language.Tag)"
        }
    }

    $primaryEntry = $languageList | Where-Object { $_.LanguageTag -eq $primaryTag }
    if ($languageList[0].LanguageTag -ne $primaryTag) {
        $languageList.Remove($primaryEntry) | Out-Null
        $languageList.Insert(0, $primaryEntry)
        Write-Output "[CHANGED] Set primary user language: $primaryTag"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] Primary user language already set: $primaryTag"
    }

    foreach ($language in $languages) {
        $tip = Get-KeyboardTip $language
        if (-not $tip) { continue }
        $keyboardDescription = if ($language.KeyboardName) { "$($language.KeyboardName) ($tip)" } else { $tip }
        $entry = $languageList | Where-Object { $_.LanguageTag -eq $language.Tag }
        if ($entry.InputMethodTips -notcontains $tip) {
            $entry.InputMethodTips.Clear()
            $entry.InputMethodTips.Add($tip) | Out-Null
            Write-Output "[CHANGED] Set keyboard layout: $keyboardDescription"
        }
        else {
            Write-Output "[PASS] Keyboard layout already present: $keyboardDescription"
        }
    }

    Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList $languageList -Force
    $primaryLanguage = $languages | Where-Object { $_.Tag -eq $primaryTag }
    Set-WinUILanguageOverride -Language $primaryTag
    Set-Culture -CultureInfo $primaryTag
    Set-WinHomeLocation -GeoId $primaryLanguage.GeoId

    Write-Output "[APPLIED] User culture: $primaryTag"
    Write-Output "[APPLIED] User UI language override: $primaryTag"
    Write-Output "[APPLIED] User home location: GeoId $($primaryLanguage.GeoId)"
    Write-Output 'Result: Remediated successfully. A new sign-in can be required for the display language.'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-Output "User language configuration failed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}

#=============================================================================================================================
#
# Script Name:     DetectClickToRunServicecState.ps1
# Description:     Purpose of this script is to detect if Office 16 installed and further if "Click to Run Service" is running
# Notes:           No variable substitution should be necessary
#
#=============================================================================================================================

# Define Variables
$curSvcStat,$svcCTRSvc,$errMsg = "","",""

# Main script
   
   
If (-not (Test-Path -Path 'hklm:\Software\Microsoft\Office\16.0')){
    Write-Host "Office 16.0 (or greater) not present on this machine"
	exit 0   
} 

Try{        
    $svcCTRSvc = Get-Service "ClickToRunSvc"
    $curSvcStat = $svcCTRSvc.Status
}

Catch{    
    $errMsg = $_.Exception.Message
    Write-Error $errMsg
    exit 1
}

If ($curSvcStat -eq "Running"){
    Write-Output $curSvcStat
    exit 0                        
}
Else{
    If($curSvcStat -eq "Stopped"){
        Write-Output $curSvcStat
        exit 1     
    }
    Else{
        Write-Error "Error: " + $errMsg
        exit 1
    }
}

#=============================================================================================================================
#
# Script Name:     RemediateClickToRunServiceState.ps1
# Description:     Purpose of this script is to start the "Click to Run Service" and change its startup type to Automatic
#       Notes:     No variable substitution needed             
#
#=============================================================================================================================

# Define Variables
$svcCur = "ClickToRunSvc"
$curSvcStat,$svcCTRSvc,$errMsg = "","",""
$ctr = 0

# First, let's make sure nothing has changed since detection and service exists and is stopped
Try{        
    $svcCTRSvc = Get-Service $svcCur
    $curSvcStat = $svcCTRSvc.Status
    }

Catch{    
    $errMsg = $_.Exception.Message
    Write-Error $errMsg
    Exit 1
    }
        
# If the service got started between detection and now (nested if) then return
# If the service got uninstalled or corrupted between detection and now (else) then return the "Error: " + the error
If ($curSvcStat -ne "Stopped"){
    If ($curSvcStat -eq "Running"){
        Write-Output "Running"
        Exit 0
    }
    Else{
        Write-Error $errMsg
        Exit 1
    }
}

# Okay, the service should be there and be stopped, we'll change the startup type and get it running
Try{        
    Set-Service $svcCur -StartupType Automatic
    Start-Service $svcCur
    $svcCTRSvc = Get-Service $svcCur
    $curSvcStat = $svcCTRSvc.Status
        While ($curSvcStat -eq "Stopped"){
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
            $ctr++
            if($ctr -eq 12){
                Write-Output "Service could not be started after 60 seconds"
                Exit 1
            }
        }
    }

Catch{    
    $errMsg = $_.Exception.Message
    Write-Error $errMsg
    Exit 1
    }

RS-ITQ-da-win-all-Detect-HP-BIOS-UEFI-CA2023 10 settings
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionThis Proactive Remediation detects whether HP devices are configured with the required Secure Boot certificate authority (CA) settings related to the Microsoft Secure Boot certificate transition. The detection script validates the following BIOS settings exposed through the HP BIOS WMI provider: Windows UEFI CA 2023 Microsoft Option ROM UEFI CA 2023 Microsoft UEFI CA 2023 Enable MS UEFI CA key Devices are reported as Compliant when all required settings are present and enabled. Devices are reported as Non-Compliant when one or more settings are missing or not configured as expected. Purpose: Identify HP devices that may not be fully prepared for the Microsoft Secure Boot certificate transition. Provide visibility into Secure Boot CA configuration across the HP device fleet. Support readiness assessments and remediation planning before future Secure Boot certificate changes. Supported Devices: HP business devices with the HP BIOS WMI provider (root\HP\InstrumentedBIOS) available. Non-HP devices are automatically skipped and reported as not applicable. Output Examples: Compliant Non-Compliant: Microsoft UEFI CA 2023 = 'Disable' (Expected: 'Enable') Non-Compliant: Enable MS UEFI CA key = 'No' (Expected: 'Yes') Remediation: Detection only. No BIOS or Secure Boot configuration changes are performed by this script.Expand

<#
    .SYNOPSIS
    Detect HP Secure Boot CA 2023 BIOS settings via Intune Proactive Remediations.

    .DESCRIPTION
    Checks required HP BIOS settings and logs detection results to C:\ProgramData\IntuneLogs\.

    .CREDITS
    written by: Faisal Rustveld & Jeffrey Bouwmeester

    .COMPANY
    ITQ

    .NOTES
    Name    : RS-ITQ-da-win-all-HPSecureBootCA2023-detect-1.0.0.ps1
    Intune Proactive Remediation - Detection Script.
    Exit 1 = Non-Compliant / remediation needed. Exit 0 = Compliant.

    .DETAILS
    Creation Date:  2026-07-31
    Version history:
        1.0.0 - (2026-07-31) - Faisal Rustveld & Jeffrey Bouwmeester - Script released

    .EXECUTION (manual)
    Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process Bypass
    .\RS-ITQ-da-win-all-HPSecureBootCA2023-detect-1.0.0.ps1
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

# --- Configuration ---
$scriptName     = "HPSecureBootCA2023"                # short identifier, used in log file names
$LogFolder      = "C:\ProgramData\IntuneLogs"
$Timestampdaily = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd"
$MaxLogsToKeep  = 5                                   # how many rotated log files to retain

# --- Helper Functions: Logging ---
function Write-CustomLog([string]$Message, [string]$LogType = 'Detect') {
    if (-not (Test-Path $LogFolder)) { New-Item $LogFolder -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null }
    $logFile = Join-Path -Path $LogFolder -ChildPath "${scriptName}_${LogType}_${Timestampdaily}.log"
    "$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_THHmmss') - $Message" | Out-File -FilePath $logFile -Append
}

function Remove-OldCustomLog {
    [CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess = $true, ConfirmImpact = 'Low')]
    param([string]$Filter)

    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($LogFolder, "Remove old custom logs matching '$Filter'")) {
        Get-ChildItem -Path $LogFolder -Filter $Filter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Sort-Object CreationTime -Descending | Select-Object -Skip $MaxLogsToKeep | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}

# --- Detection Functions: HP BIOS Secure Boot CA 2023 ---
function Get-HPBiosSettings {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()

    try {
        return Get-CimInstance `
            -Namespace root\HP\InstrumentedBIOS `
            -ClassName HP_BIOSEnumeration `
            -ErrorAction Stop
    }
    catch {
        Write-CustomLog -Message "HP BIOS WMI provider not found."
        Write-Output "Non-Compliant: HP BIOS WMI provider not found."
        Write-CustomLog -Message "Non-compliant"
        exit 1
    }
}

function Test-HPBiosSetting {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$HpSettings,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SettingName,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ExpectedValue
    )

    $currentSetting = $HpSettings | Where-Object {
        $_.Name -eq $SettingName
    } | Select-Object -First 1

    if (-not $currentSetting) {
        Write-CustomLog -Message "$SettingName not found."
        return [PSCustomObject]@{
            Name         = $SettingName
            CurrentValue = "Not Found"
            ExpectedValue = $ExpectedValue
            IsCompliant = $false
        }
    }

    $isSettingCompliant = $currentSetting.CurrentValue -eq $ExpectedValue

    if ($isSettingCompliant) {
        Write-CustomLog -Message "$SettingName = '$($currentSetting.CurrentValue)' - Compliant"
    }
    else {
        Write-CustomLog -Message "$SettingName = '$($currentSetting.CurrentValue)' (Expected: '$ExpectedValue')"
    }

    return [PSCustomObject]@{
        Name         = $SettingName
        CurrentValue = $currentSetting.CurrentValue
        ExpectedValue = $ExpectedValue
        IsCompliant = $isSettingCompliant
    }
}

function Test-HPBiosSecureBootCA2023 {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$HpSettings,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][hashtable]$ExpectedSettings
    )

    $results = @()

    foreach ($settingName in $ExpectedSettings.Keys) {
        $results += Test-HPBiosSetting `
            -HpSettings $HpSettings `
            -SettingName $settingName `
            -ExpectedValue $ExpectedSettings[$settingName]
    }

    return $results
}

# --- Output Functions ---
function Format-PolicyResult {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][object]$Result)

    $status = if ($Result.IsCompliant) { "Compliant" } else { "Non-Compliant" }
    return "$($Result.Name): $($Result.CurrentValue) - $status"
}

function Format-IntunePolicyResult {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][object]$Result)

    $settingAlias = Get-IntuneSettingAlias -SettingName $Result.Name
    return "$settingAlias=$($Result.CurrentValue)"
}

function Format-IntunePolicyIssue {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][object]$Result)

    $settingAlias = Get-IntuneSettingAlias -SettingName $Result.Name
    return "$settingAlias=$($Result.CurrentValue) (Expected $($Result.ExpectedValue))"
}

function Get-IntuneSettingAlias {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$SettingName)

    $settingAlias = switch ($SettingName) {
        "Windows UEFI CA 2023" { "CA2023" }
        "Microsoft Option ROM UEFI CA 2023" { "OptionROM2023" }
        "Microsoft UEFI CA 2023" { "MSUEFI2023" }
        "Enable MS UEFI CA key" { "MSUEFIKey" }
        default { $SettingName -replace '\s+', '' }
    }
    return $settingAlias
}

function Write-IntuneDetectionOutput {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][bool]$IsCompliant,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$Results
    )

    $outputParts = @()

    if ($IsCompliant) {
        $outputParts += "Compliant"
    }
    else {
        $issues = $Results | Where-Object { -not $_.IsCompliant } | ForEach-Object {
            Format-IntunePolicyIssue -Result $_
        }
        $outputParts += "Non-Compliant"
        $outputParts += "Reason: $($issues -join ', ')"
    }

    foreach ($result in $Results) {
        $outputParts += Format-IntunePolicyResult -Result $result
    }

    Write-Output ($outputParts -join " | ")
}

function Write-DetectionSummaryLog {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][bool]$IsCompliant,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][object[]]$Results
    )

    $overallStatus = if ($IsCompliant) { "Compliant" } else { "Non-compliant" }
    Write-CustomLog -Message $overallStatus

    foreach ($result in $Results) {
        Write-CustomLog -Message (Format-PolicyResult -Result $result)
    }
}

# --- Initialize & Clean Logs ---
Remove-OldCustomLog -Filter "${scriptName}_Detect_*.log" -Confirm:$false
Write-CustomLog -Message " "
Write-CustomLog -Message "=== START DETECTION ==="

# --- Detection Logic ---

$isCompliant = $true

$ExpectedSettings = @{
    "Windows UEFI CA 2023"              = "Enable"
    "Microsoft Option ROM UEFI CA 2023" = "Enable"
    "Microsoft UEFI CA 2023"            = "Enable"
    "Enable MS UEFI CA key"             = "Yes"
}

$HpSettings = Get-HPBiosSettings
$DetectionResults = @(Test-HPBiosSecureBootCA2023 -HpSettings $HpSettings -ExpectedSettings $ExpectedSettings)

if ($DetectionResults.IsCompliant -contains $false) {
    $isCompliant = $false
}

# --- Intune Output & Exit ---
if ($isCompliant) {
    Write-DetectionSummaryLog -IsCompliant $true -Results $DetectionResults
    Write-IntuneDetectionOutput -IsCompliant $true -Results $DetectionResults
    exit 0
} else {
    Write-DetectionSummaryLog -IsCompliant $false -Results $DetectionResults
    Write-IntuneDetectionOutput -IsCompliant $false -Results $DetectionResults
    exit 1
}

RS-ITQ-da-win-all-Hardening-DisableCoInstallers 10 settings Intune - Pro Active Remediation

DescriptionThis remediation script proactively hardens the Windows Plug and Play (PnP) device installation process by setting the 'DisableCoInstallers' registry value to 1. Co-installers are vendor-provided DLLs that execute with SYSTEM privileges during hardware installation. Disabling them mitigates the risk of Local Privilege Escalation (LPE) attacks, where malicious actors use rogue USB devices or compromised drivers to execute arbitrary code with highest system privileges. Lifecycle Note: This is a permanent Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) measure based on security best practices and penetration test findings. It should remain active across all current and future Windows 11 builds to prevent hardware-based privilege escalation.Expand

﻿# Registry path and key to check
$keyPath = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Device Installer"
$valueName = "DisableCoInstallers"
$expectedValue = 1

RS-ITQ-da-win-all-Hardening-Pre25H2-DisablePSv2 10 settings Intune - Pro Active Remediation
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionThis remediation script proactively disables Windows PowerShell 2.0 to harden the operating system against downgrade attacks. PowerShell 2.0 does not support modern security features such as Constrained Language Mode (CLM) or Antimalware Scan Interface (AMSI), making it a significant security risk. Lifecycle Note: This is a temporary hardening measure intended for devices running Windows versions prior to 25H2. Because Microsoft natively deprecates and removes the PowerShell 2.0 engine in Windows 11 24H2/25H2, this remediation script can be safely retired once the entire fleet has been upgraded to 25H2 or newer.Expand

﻿<#
.SYNOPSIS
    This script checks if Windows PowerShell version 2.0 is enabled on the system.
    Powershell 2 cannot be set to Constrained Language Mode (CLM) and is therefor a security threat

.DESCRIPTION
    The script uses the Get-WindowsOptionalFeature cmdlet to get the status of the "MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2Root" feature, which represents Windows PowerShell version 2.0. If the feature is enabled, the script exits with a status code of 1.

.NOTES
    Filename: DisablePowershell2Detection.ps1
    Version: 1.0
    Co-Author : Sandor Broers
    Thanks to: Martin Bengtsson
    WWW: https://www.imab.dk/reduce-your-attack-surface-by-uninstalling-powershell-version-2-using-powershell-and-microsoft-intune/      
#>
# Get the state of the PowerShell v2.0 feature
try {
    $PoShv2Enabled = Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -FeatureName "MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2Root" -Online | Select-Object -ExpandProperty State
} catch {
    Write-Error "Failed to get the state of the PowerShell v2.0 feature: $_"
    exit 1
}
# If the feature is enabled, exit with a status code of 1
if ($PoShv2Enabled -eq "Enabled") {
    Write-Output "Non-Compliant, Powershell 2 feature is NOT $PoShv2Enabled"
    exit 1
} else {
    Write-Output "Compliant, Powershell 2 feature is $PoShv2Enabled"
    exit 0  # Return zero exit code for compliance
}
Remediation Script Content
View script
﻿<#
.SYNOPSIS
    This script checks if Windows PowerShell version 2.0 is enabled on the system and disables it if it is.
    Powershell 2 cannot be set to Constrained Language Mode (CLM) and is therefor a security threat

.DESCRIPTION
    The script uses the Get-WindowsOptionalFeature cmdlet to get the status of the "MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2Root" feature, which represents Windows PowerShell version 2.0. If the feature is enabled, the script attempts to disable it using the Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature cmdlet.

.NOTES
    Filename: DisablePowershell2Remediation.ps1
    Version: 1.0
    Co-Author : Sandor Broers
    Thanks to: Martin Bengtsson
    WWW: https://www.imab.dk/reduce-your-attack-surface-by-uninstalling-powershell-version-2-using-powershell-and-microsoft-intune/
#>
# Get the state of the PowerShell v2.0 feature
try {
    $PoShv2Enabled = Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -FeatureName "MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2Root" -Online | Select-Object -ExpandProperty State
} catch {
    Write-Error "Failed to get the state of the PowerShell v2.0 feature: $_"
    exit 1
}
# If the feature is enabled, try to disable it
if ($PoShv2Enabled -eq "Enabled") {
    try {
        Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2Root -ErrorAction Stop
        Write-Output "Powershell 2 feature disabled"
        exit 0
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to disable the PowerShell v2.0 feature: $_"
        exit 1
    }
}

RS-ITQ-da-win-all-Hardening-Pre25H2-RestrictWMIC 10 settings Intune - Pro Active Remediation
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionThis remediation script proactively restricts standard user access to the Windows Management Instrumentation Command-line tool (WMIC.exe). It removes the 'Users' group permissions from the executable in both System32 and SysWOW64 directories. This hardening measure mitigates the risk of attackers and malware utilizing WMIC as a 'Living off the Land' Binary (LOLBin) to bypass security controls, execute unauthorized processes, or perform system reconnaissance. Lifecycle Note: This mitigation was implemented based on security penetration test findings. Because Microsoft has officially deprecated WMIC and removes it by default starting from Windows 11 24H2/25H2, this remediation script is a temporary hardening measure. It can be safely retired once the entire device fleet has been upgraded to 25H2 or newer.Expand

ScopeTags0

SettingValue
PublisherChris Koopman
Detection Script Content
View script
﻿# Paths to certutil.exe files
$files = @(
    "C:\Windows\System32\wbem\WMIC.exe",
    "C:\Windows\SysWOW64\wbem\WMIC.exe"
)

# Function to resolve the localized name for the Users group
function Get-LocalizedUsersGroup {
    try {
        # Create a SecurityIdentifier object for the Users group SID
        $usersSID = New-Object System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier("S-1-5-32-545")
        
        # Translate the SID to a localized NTAccount (e.g., BUILTIN\Users or localized equivalent)
        $usersGroup = $usersSID.Translate([System.Security.Principal.NTAccount]).Value
        
        #Write-Output "Localized Users group: $usersGroup"
        return $usersGroup
    } catch {
        Write-Output "Failed to resolve Users group SID to a localized name. Error: $_"
        return $null
    }
}

# Function to check if Users group has permissions on a file
function Check-UserPermissions {
    param (
        [string]$FilePath,
        [string]$UsersGroupName
    )

    if (Test-Path $FilePath) {
        Write-Output "Checking permissions for $FilePath"

        # Get the ACL of the file
        $acl = Get-Acl $FilePath

        # Filter ACL entries for the localized Users group
        $usersPermission = $acl.Access | Where-Object { $_.IdentityReference -eq $UsersGroupName }

        # Return true or false explicitly based on the check
        if ($usersPermission -and $usersPermission.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-Output "Users group has permissions on $FilePath"
            return $true
        } else {
            Write-Output "Users group does NOT have permissions on $FilePath"
            return $false
        }
    } else {
        Write-Output "$FilePath does not exist. Skipping check."
        return $false
    }
}

# Main logic
$localizedUsersGroup = Get-LocalizedUsersGroup
if (-not $localizedUsersGroup) {
    Write-Output "Cannot determine the localized Users group. Exiting."
    exit 1
}

$nonCompliant = $false

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $result = Check-UserPermissions -FilePath $file -UsersGroupName $localizedUsersGroup
    if ($result -eq $true) {
        $nonCompliant = $true
    }
}

# Output result for detection
if ($nonCompliant) {
    Write-Output "Non-compliant: Users group has permissions on one or more files."
    exit 1  # Return a non-zero exit code for non-compliance
} else {
    Write-Output "Compliant: Users group does not have permissions on the files."
    exit 0  # Return zero exit code for compliance
}
Remediation Script Content
View script
﻿# Paths to certutil.exe files
$files = @(
    "C:\Windows\System32\wbem\WMIC.exe",
    "C:\Windows\SysWOW64\wbem\WMIC.exe"
)

# Function to set ownership and permissions
function Update-FilePermissions {
    param (
        [string]$FilePath
    )

    # Check if the file exists
    if (Test-Path $FilePath) {
        Write-Output "Processing $FilePath"

        # Take ownership of the file
        Write-Output "Taking ownership of $FilePath"
        $takeownResult = takeown /f $FilePath 2>&1
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Error "Failed to take ownership of $FilePath. Error: $takeownResult"
            return
        }

        # SID of the 'Users' group
        $usersSid = "*S-1-5-32-545"  # Well-known SID for BUILTIN\Users group

        # Remove 'Users' group from the file permissions using its SID
        Write-Output "Removing 'Users' group (SID: $usersSid) from $FilePath"
        $icaclsResult = icacls $FilePath /remove:g "$usersSid" 2>&1
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Error "Failed to remove 'Users' group from $FilePath. Error: $icaclsResult"
            return
        }

        # Restore ownership to TrustedInstaller using PowerShell
        Write-Output "Restoring ownership to TrustedInstaller for $FilePath"
        try {
            $owner = "NT SERVICE\TrustedInstaller"
            $acl = Get-Acl $FilePath
            $acl.SetOwner([System.Security.Principal.NTAccount]$owner)
            $setAclResult = Set-Acl $FilePath $acl
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
                Write-Error "Failed to update ACL for $FilePath."
                return
            }
            Write-Output "Ownership successfully restored to TrustedInstaller for $FilePath"
        } catch {
            Write-Error "Failed to restore ownership to TrustedInstaller for $FilePath $_"
        }

        Write-Output "Completed processing $FilePath"
    } else {
        Write-Output "$FilePath does not exist."
    }
}

# Process each file in the list
foreach ($file in $files) {
    try {
        Update-FilePermissions -FilePath $file
    } catch {
        Write-Error "An error occurred while processing $file $_"
    }
}

RS-ITQ-da-win-all-Hardening-Securebootcerts 10 settings Intune - Pro Active Remediation Intune - All Policies
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionThis remediation script detects and facilitates the deployment of the 'Windows UEFI CA 2023' certificate to the device's Secure Boot database. This action is part of Microsoft's industry-wide Secure Boot PKI rollover to replace the expiring 2011 trust anchors and to mitigate advanced UEFI bootkit threats (such as the BlackLotus vulnerability, CVE-2023-24932). Lifecycle Note: This is a transitional infrastructure and hardening measure. It ensures the device firmware is proactively prepared for the mandatory revocation phase of the old certificates. This script can be safely retired once the entire fleet has successfully imported the 2023 CA and Microsoft natively enforces the revocation via Windows Updates in newer OS builds (e.g., 24H2/25H2).Expand
Created18/03/2026 13:09:52
Modified31/03/2026 07:24:44
ScopeTags0
Settings
SettingValue
PublisherJeffrey Bouwmeester
Detection Script Content
View script
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Intune detection script for Secure Boot CA 2023 update.

.DESCRIPTION
  Returns compliant (exit 0) if Secure Boot CA 2023 appears fully deployed:
    - UEFICA2023Status = "Updated" OR WindowsUEFICA2023Capable = 2
    AND
    - UEFICA2023Error is missing or 0

  Otherwise exits 1 so the remediation script can run.
#>

$servicingPath = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecureBoot\Servicing"

function Get-RegValue {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Name
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
        return $null
    }

    try {
        $props = Get-ItemProperty -Path $Path -Name $Name -ErrorAction Stop
        return $props.$Name
    }
    catch {
        return $null
    }
}


# Check if Secure Boot UEFI database contains the 2023 certificate
try {
    $db = Get-SecureBootUEFI -Name db
    $dbString = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($db.Bytes)
} catch {
    Write-Output "Error: Unable to read Secure Boot UEFI DB. Device may not support Secure Boot or access is blocked."
}

# Match for the new certificate
$match = $dbString -match 'Windows UEFI CA 2023'

if ($match) {
    Write-Output "Compliant: Windows UEFI CA 2023 is present in the Secure Boot database."
    exit 0
} else {
    Write-Output "Non-Compliant: Windows UEFI CA 2023 not found in the Secure Boot database."
}



$uefiStatus  = Get-RegValue -Path $servicingPath -Name "UEFICA2023Status"
$uefiError   = Get-RegValue -Path $servicingPath -Name "UEFICA2023Error"
$uefiCapable = Get-RegValue -Path $servicingPath -Name "WindowsUEFICA2023Capable"

$updated = $false



if (
    ($uefiStatus -eq "Updated" -or $uefiCapable -eq 2) -and
    ($null -eq $uefiError -or $uefiError -eq 0)
) {
    $updated = $true
}

if ($updated) {
    Write-Output "Secure Boot CA 2023: Update deployed (Status='$uefiStatus', Capable=$uefiCapable, Error=$uefiError)."
    exit 0
}
else {
    Write-Output "Secure Boot CA 2023: Not fully updated yet. Status='$uefiStatus', Capable=$uefiCapable, Error=$uefiError."
    exit 1
}

# Detection for CVE-2013-3900 EnableCertPaddingCheck

$regPath1 = "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Cryptography\Wintrust\Config"
$regPath2 = "HKLM:\Software\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Cryptography\Wintrust\Config"

$requiredValue = "1"

function Test-Key {
    param($path)
    try {
        $val = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name EnableCertPaddingCheck -ErrorAction Stop).EnableCertPaddingCheck
        return $val -eq $requiredValue
    }
    catch {
        return $false
    }
}

$ok1 = Test-Key -path $regPath1
$ok2 = Test-Key -path $regPath2

if ($ok1 -and $ok2) {
    Write-Output "Mitigation is correctly applied."
    exit 0
}
else {
    Write-Output "Mitigation missing or incorrect."
    exit 1
}

# Remediation for CVE-2013-3900 EnableCertPaddingCheck

$regPath1 = "HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Cryptography\Wintrust\Config"
$regPath2 = "HKLM:\Software\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Cryptography\Wintrust\Config"

# Ensure paths exist
if (-not (Test-Path $regPath1)) { New-Item -Path $regPath1 -Force | Out-Null }
if (-not (Test-Path $regPath2)) { New-Item -Path $regPath2 -Force | Out-Null }

# Set mitigation values
Set-ItemProperty -Path $regPath1 -Name EnableCertPaddingCheck -Value "1" -Type String
Set-ItemProperty -Path $regPath2 -Name EnableCertPaddingCheck -Value "1" -Type String

Write-Output "Mitigation for CVE-2013-3900 applied successfully."
exit 0

# Detect Intel CPU and mitigation state for CVE-2022-0001

$cpu = Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Manufacturer
$regPath = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management"

# Required values per Microsoft docs
$RequiredOverride     = 0x00800000
$RequiredMask         = 0x00000003

# If not Intel, no action needed
if ($cpu -notlike "*Intel*") {
    Write-Output "Non-Intel CPU detected. No mitigation required."
    exit 0
}

# Check if registry keys exist
try {
    $override = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $regPath -Name FeatureSettingsOverride -ErrorAction Stop).FeatureSettingsOverride
    $mask     = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $regPath -Name FeatureSettingsOverrideMask -ErrorAction Stop).FeatureSettingsOverrideMask
}
catch {
    Write-Output "Mitigation registry keys missing."
    exit 1
}

# Compare values
if ($override -eq $RequiredOverride -and $mask -eq $RequiredMask) {
    Write-Output "Mitigation is correctly applied."
    exit 0
}
else {
    Write-Output "Mitigation incorrect or incomplete."
    exit 1
}
Remediation Script Content
View script
# Apply mitigation for CVE-2022-0001 on Intel CPUs

$cpu = Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Manufacturer
$regPath = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management"

# Required registry values
$RequiredOverride     = 0x00800000
$RequiredMask         = 0x00000003

# Skip remediation on non-Intel CPUs
if ($cpu -notlike "*Intel*") {
    Write-Output "Non-Intel CPU detected. Skipping remediation."
    exit 0
}

# Ensure key exists
if (-not (Test-Path $regPath)) {
    New-Item -Path $regPath -Force | Out-Null
}

# Apply required values
Set-ItemProperty -Path $regPath -Name FeatureSettingsOverride -Value $RequiredOverride -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty -Path $regPath -Name FeatureSettingsOverrideMask -Value $RequiredMask -Type DWord

Write-Output "Mitigation for CVE-2022-0001 applied successfully."
exit 0

Detection Script Content
View script
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Detection script for Intune to check whether CVE-2026-45585 WinRE mitigation has been applied.

.DESCRIPTION
    Detection script, intended for Intune remediation deployment.
    Runs as SYSTEM / Administrator.
    Mounts WinRE, loads the offline SYSTEM hive, checks whether
    autofstx.exe is still present in Session Manager BootExecute.

    Run this script using the logged-on credentials: NO.
    Enforce script signature check: NO.
    Run script in 64-bit PowerShell: YES.

.NOTES
    May 2026

    https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-45585

    AI assistance with Invoke-Process, and the need to check for Timeout.
    Initially the script would just pause on mounting the WinRE...
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$ProgramDataPath = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('CommonApplicationData')
$SystemDrivePath = $env:SystemDrive

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SystemDrivePath)) {
    $SystemDrivePath = $env:SystemRoot.Substring(0,2)
}

$LogRoot     = Join-Path $ProgramDataPath 'Microsoft\IntuneManagementExtension\Logs'
$LogFile     = Join-Path $LogRoot 'Detect-CVE-2026-45585-WinRE.log'
$MountPath   = Join-Path $SystemDrivePath "WinRE-Detect-$([guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
$HiveName    = 'WinREDetectHive'
$HiveRoot    = "HKLM:\$HiveName"
$HiveRegPath = "HKLM\$HiveName"

function Write-Log {
    param(
        [string]$Message,
        [ValidateSet('INFO','WARN','ERROR','COMPLIANT','NONCOMPLIANT','DEBUG')]
        [string]$Level = 'INFO'
    )

    if (-not (Test-Path $LogRoot)) {
        New-Item -Path $LogRoot -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    }

    $TimeStamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff'
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value "[$TimeStamp] [$Level] $Message"
}

function Invoke-Process {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string]$FilePath,

        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string[]]$ArgumentList,

        [int[]]$SuccessExitCodes = @(0),

        [int]$TimeoutSeconds = 300
    )

    $ArgumentString = $ArgumentList -join ' '
    $StdOutFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP "$([guid]::NewGuid())-stdout.log"
    $StdErrFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP "$([guid]::NewGuid())-stderr.log"

    Write-Log "Starting process: $FilePath $ArgumentString" 'DEBUG'
    Write-Log "TimeoutSeconds: $TimeoutSeconds" 'DEBUG'

    $Process = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process
    $Process.StartInfo.FileName = $FilePath
    $Process.StartInfo.Arguments = $ArgumentString
    $Process.StartInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
    $Process.StartInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
    $Process.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
    $Process.StartInfo.RedirectStandardError = $true

    $Started = $Process.Start()

    if (-not $Started) {
        throw "Failed to start process: $FilePath"
    }

    $StartTime = Get-Date
    Write-Log "Process started. PID=$($Process.Id)" 'DEBUG'

    while (-not $Process.HasExited) {
        $Elapsed = [int]((Get-Date) - $StartTime).TotalSeconds

        Write-Log "Process still running. PID=$($Process.Id), ElapsedSeconds=$Elapsed, Command=$FilePath $ArgumentString" 'DEBUG'

        if ($Elapsed -ge $TimeoutSeconds) {
            Write-Log "Process timeout reached. Attempting to kill PID=$($Process.Id)" 'ERROR'

            try {
                $Process.Kill()
                $Process.WaitForExit()
            }
            catch {
                Write-Log "Failed to kill process: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'ERROR'
            }

            throw "$FilePath timed out after $TimeoutSeconds seconds"
        }

        Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
    }

    $StdOut = $Process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()
    $StdErr = $Process.StandardError.ReadToEnd()
    $ExitCode = $Process.ExitCode

    Write-Log "Process completed. PID=$($Process.Id), ExitCode=$ExitCode" 'DEBUG'

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($StdOut)) {
        Write-Log "STDOUT from $FilePath`: $StdOut" 'DEBUG'
    }

    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($StdErr)) {
        Write-Log "STDERR from $FilePath`: $StdErr" 'WARN'
    }

    if ($ExitCode -notin $SuccessExitCodes) {
        throw "$FilePath failed with exit code $ExitCode"
    }
}

function Cleanup-WinREDetection {
    Write-Log 'Starting cleanup routine.' 'DEBUG'

    try {
        if (Test-Path $HiveRoot) {
            Write-Log "Cleanup: unloading registry hive $HiveRegPath" 'WARN'
            reg.exe unload $HiveRegPath | Out-Null
            Write-Log 'Cleanup: registry hive unloaded.' 'DEBUG'
        }
        else {
            Write-Log "Cleanup: registry hive $HiveRegPath is not loaded." 'DEBUG'
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Log "Cleanup: failed to unload registry hive: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'ERROR'
    }

    try {
        if (Test-Path $MountPath) {
            Write-Log "Cleanup: attempting WinRE unmount/discard from $MountPath" 'WARN'
            reagentc.exe /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard | Out-Null
            Write-Log 'Cleanup: WinRE unmount/discard attempted.' 'DEBUG'
        }
        else {
            Write-Log "Cleanup: mount path does not exist, skipping reagentc discard: $MountPath" 'DEBUG'
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Log "Cleanup: failed to unmount/discard WinRE image: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'ERROR'
    }

    try {
        if (Test-Path $MountPath) {
            Write-Log "Cleanup: removing temporary mount path $MountPath" 'DEBUG'
            Remove-Item -Path $MountPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Write-Log 'Cleanup: temporary mount path removal attempted.' 'DEBUG'
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Log "Cleanup: failed to remove temporary mount path: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'ERROR'
    }

    Write-Log 'Cleanup routine completed.' 'DEBUG'
}

try {
    Write-Log '============================================================'
    Write-Log 'Starting CVE-2026-45585 WinRE detection.'
    Write-Log "Running as: $([Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name)" 'DEBUG'
    Write-Log "PowerShell version: $($PSVersionTable.PSVersion)" 'DEBUG'
    Write-Log "SystemDrivePath: $SystemDrivePath" 'DEBUG'
    Write-Log "MountPath: $MountPath" 'DEBUG'

    Write-Log 'Checking current Windows RE status.' 'DEBUG'
    Invoke-Process -FilePath 'reagentc.exe' -ArgumentList @('/info')

    Write-Log "Creating temporary mount path: $MountPath" 'DEBUG'
    New-Item -Path $MountPath -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null

    Write-Log 'Mounting WinRE image.' 'INFO'
    Invoke-Process -FilePath 'reagentc.exe' -ArgumentList @('/mountre', '/path', $MountPath) -TimeoutSeconds 300
    #Invoke-Process -FilePath 'reagentc.exe' -ArgumentList @('/mountre', '/path', $MountPath)
    Write-Log 'WinRE image mounted successfully.' 'INFO'

    $SystemHivePath = Join-Path $MountPath 'Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM'
    Write-Log "Expected offline SYSTEM hive path: $SystemHivePath" 'DEBUG'

    if (-not (Test-Path $SystemHivePath)) {
        throw "Offline SYSTEM hive not found at $SystemHivePath"
    }

    Write-Log "Loading offline SYSTEM hive into $HiveRegPath" 'INFO'
    Invoke-Process -FilePath 'reg.exe' -ArgumentList @('load', $HiveRegPath, $SystemHivePath)
    Write-Log 'Offline SYSTEM hive loaded successfully.' 'INFO'

    $SelectPath = Join-Path $HiveRoot 'Select'
    $DefaultControlSet = 'ControlSet001'

    if (Test-Path $SelectPath) {
        $Select = Get-ItemProperty -Path $SelectPath
        Write-Log "Select.Default value: $($Select.Default)" 'DEBUG'

        if ($Select.Default) {
            $DefaultControlSet = 'ControlSet{0:D3}' -f [int]$Select.Default
        }
    }    
    else {
        Write-Log 'Select key not found. Falling back to ControlSet001.' 'WARN'
    }

    Write-Log "Using control set: $DefaultControlSet" 'INFO'

    $SessionManagerPath = Join-Path $HiveRoot "$DefaultControlSet\Control\Session Manager"
    Write-Log "Session Manager path: $SessionManagerPath" 'DEBUG'

    if (-not (Test-Path $SessionManagerPath)) {
        throw "Session Manager registry path not found: $SessionManagerPath"
    }

    Write-Log 'Reading BootExecute value.' 'INFO'
    $BootExecute = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $SessionManagerPath -Name 'BootExecute' -ErrorAction Stop).BootExecute

    if ($null -eq $BootExecute) {
        Write-Log 'BootExecute is null or missing. Treating as compliant.' 'COMPLIANT'
        $DetectionResult = 0
    }    
    else {
        foreach ($Entry in @($BootExecute)) {
            Write-Log "BootExecute entry: $Entry" 'DEBUG'
        }

        if (@($BootExecute) -match '(?i)\bautofstx\.exe\b') {
            #Write-Log 'autofstx.exe is present. Device is non-compliant.' 'NONCOMPLIANT'
            $DetectionResult = 1
        }        
        else {
            #Write-Log 'autofstx.exe is not present. Device is compliant.' 'COMPLIANT'
            $DetectionResult = 0
        }
    }

    Write-Log "Unloading offline SYSTEM hive from $HiveRegPath" 'INFO'
    Invoke-Process -FilePath 'reg.exe' -ArgumentList @('unload', $HiveRegPath)
    Write-Log 'Offline SYSTEM hive unloaded successfully.' 'INFO'

    Write-Log "Unmounting WinRE image from $MountPath using discard." 'INFO'
    #Invoke-Process -FilePath 'reagentc.exe' -ArgumentList @('/unmountre', '/path', $MountPath, '/discard')
    Invoke-Process -FilePath 'reagentc.exe' -ArgumentList @('/unmountre', '/path', $MountPath, '/discard') -TimeoutSeconds 300
    Write-Log 'WinRE image unmounted successfully.' 'INFO'

    if (Test-Path $MountPath) {
        Write-Log "Removing temporary mount path: $MountPath" 'DEBUG'
        Remove-Item -Path $MountPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }

    Write-Log "Detection completed. ExitCode=$DetectionResult" 'INFO'
    switch ($DetectionResult) {
        1 {
            Write-Log 'autofstx.exe is present. Device is non-compliant.' 'NONCOMPLIANT'
            Write-Output 'Non-compliant: autofstx.exe is present in WinRE BootExecute.'
            exit 1
        }

        0 {
            Write-Log 'autofstx.exe is not present. Device is compliant.' 'COMPLIANT'
            Write-Output 'Compliant: autofstx.exe is not present in WinRE BootExecute.'
            exit 0
        }

        default {
            Write-Log 'Detection failed, check logs.' 'NONCOMPLIANT'            
            Write-Output 'Detection failed, check logs.'
            exit 1
        }
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Log "Detection failed: $($_.Exception.Message)" 'ERROR'

    if ($_.ScriptStackTrace) {
        Write-Log "Script stack trace: $($_.ScriptStackTrace)" 'DEBUG'
    }

    Cleanup-WinREDetection

    exit 1
}
Remediation Script Content
View script
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Removes autofstx.exe from the WinRE BootExecute registry value.

.DESCRIPTION
    This remediation script removes the "autofstx.exe" entry from the BootExecute
    REG_MULTI_SZ value inside the Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE) offline
    SYSTEM registry hive. This is a security fix to prevent autofstx.exe from
    executing during WinRE boot.

    The script performs the following steps:
      1. Verify administrator privileges
      2. Verify WinRE is enabled
      3. Mount the WinRE image via reagentc
      4. Load the offline SYSTEM registry hive
      5. Read BootExecute and remove autofstx.exe if present
      6. Unload the offline hive
      7. Unmount the WinRE image with commit
      8. Disable and re-enable WinRE to re-seal BitLocker trust chain

    Exit 0 = Success (entry removed or not present)
    Exit 1 = Failure (error during remediation)

.PARAMETER MountPath
    Directory to use as the WinRE mount point. Created if it does not exist.
    Default: C:\Mount

.EXAMPLE
    # Standard run
    .\Remove-AutoFsTxFromWinRE.ps1

.EXAMPLE
    # Custom mount path
    .\Remove-AutoFsTxFromWinRE.ps1 -MountPath D:\mount

.NOTES
    Requirements: Windows with WinRE and reagentc support, Administrator privileges.
    The WinRE disable/enable cycle at the end is required to re-seal the
    BitLocker measurement chain after modifying the WinRE image.

    THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
    IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
    FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
    AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
    LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
    OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
    SOFTWARE.
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$MountPath = "C:\Mount"
)

# Target entry to remove from BootExecute
$EntryToRemove = "autofstx.exe"

# Internal constant for the offline hive key name
$HiveName = "WinREHive"

# State tracking for cleanup
$hiveLoaded   = $false
$imageMounted = $false
$mountCreated = $false
$changesMade  = $false

Write-Host "Remove autofstx.exe from WinRE BootExecute"

# 1. Verify Administrator Privileges
# PS Version: All | Admin: Yes | System Requirements: None
try {
    $identity  = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
    $principal = [Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]$identity
    $isAdmin   = $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)

    if (-not $isAdmin) {
        Write-Host "[1/8] Administrator check: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Host "  This script must be run as Administrator."
        Write-Host "  Right-click PowerShell and select 'Run as administrator'."
        exit 1
    }

    Write-Host "[1/8] Administrator check: Passed" -ForegroundColor Green
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Error checking administrator privileges: $_"
    exit 1
}

# 2. Check WinRE Status
# PS Version: All | Admin: Yes | System Requirements: reagentc.exe
try {
    $winreOutput = & reagentc /info 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[2/8] WinRE status check: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Warning "reagentc /info returned exit code $LASTEXITCODE"
        exit 1
    }
    $winreOutputStr = $winreOutput -join "`n"

# Make this check language agnostic 
   if ($winreOutputStr -match "[:：]\s*Enabled\b") {
       Write-Host "[2/8] WinRE status: Enabled" -ForegroundColor Green
       } else {
          Write-Host "[2/8] WinRE status: NOT ENABLED. Exiting." -ForegroundColor Green
          exit 0
      }
	 } catch {
    Write-Warning "Error checking WinRE status: $_"
    exit 1
}

# 3. Mount WinRE Image
# PS Version: All | Admin: Yes | System Requirements: reagentc.exe
try {
    if (-not (Test-Path $MountPath)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $MountPath -Force | Out-Null
        $mountCreated = $true
        Write-Host "[3/8] Created mount directory: $MountPath"
    } else {
        $existing = Get-ChildItem -Path $MountPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($existing) {
            Write-Host "[3/8] Mount WinRE image: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host "  Mount directory $MountPath is not empty."
            Write-Host "  Clean it or specify a different -MountPath."
            exit 1
        }
    }

    $mountOutput = & reagentc /mountre /path $MountPath 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[3/8] Mount WinRE image: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Warning "reagentc /mountre output: $mountOutput"
        exit 1
    }

    $imageMounted = $true
    Write-Host "[3/8] WinRE image mounted: $MountPath" -ForegroundColor Green
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Error mounting WinRE image: $_"
    exit 1
}

# 4. Load Offline SYSTEM Registry Hive
# PS Version: All | Admin: Yes | System Requirements: reg.exe
try {
    # Locate the SYSTEM hive in the mounted WinRE image
    $hivePath = $null
    $hiveCandidates = @(
        "$MountPath\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM",
        "$MountPath\windows\system32\config\SYSTEM"
    )

    foreach ($candidate in $hiveCandidates) {
        if (Test-Path $candidate) {
            $hivePath = $candidate
            break
        }
    }

    if (-not $hivePath) {
        # Broader search as fallback
        $found = Get-ChildItem -Path $MountPath -Recurse -Filter "SYSTEM" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                 Where-Object { $_.FullName -match "config\\SYSTEM$" } |
                 Select-Object -First 1

        if ($found) {
            $hivePath = $found.FullName
        }
    }

    if (-not $hivePath) {
        Write-Host "[4/8] Load offline hive: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Warning "Cannot locate SYSTEM hive in mounted WinRE image."

        # Cleanup: unmount with discard
        $null = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
        $imageMounted = $false
        exit 1
    }

    Write-Host "[4/8] Found SYSTEM hive: $hivePath"

    $loadOutput = & reg load "HKLM\$HiveName" $hivePath 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[4/8] Load offline hive: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Warning "reg load output: $loadOutput"

        # Cleanup: unmount with discard
        $null = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
        $imageMounted = $false
        exit 1
    }

    $hiveLoaded = $true
    Write-Host "[4/8] Hive loaded as HKLM\$HiveName" -ForegroundColor Green
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Error loading offline hive: $_"

    if ($imageMounted) {
        $null = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
        $imageMounted = $false
    }
    exit 1
}

# 5. Read BootExecute and Remove autofstx.exe
# PS Version: All | Admin: Yes | System Requirements: None
try {
    # Determine active ControlSets from Select key
    $selectPath = "Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\$HiveName\Select"
    $selectProps = Get-ItemProperty -Path $selectPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

    if ($selectProps -and $selectProps.Current) {
        $csNumbers = @($selectProps.Current)
        if ($selectProps.Default -and $selectProps.Default -ne $selectProps.Current) {
            $csNumbers += $selectProps.Default
        }
        $controlSets = $csNumbers | ForEach-Object { "ControlSet{0:D3}" -f [int]$_ }
        Write-Host "[5/8] Active ControlSets (from Select key): $($controlSets -join ', ')"
    } else {
        $controlSets = @("ControlSet001")
        Write-Host "[5/8] Select key not readable, falling back to ControlSet001"
    }

    # Remediate all relevant ControlSets
    $foundEntry = $false

    foreach ($cs in $controlSets) {
        $regPath = "Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\$HiveName\$cs\Control\Session Manager"
        $testResult = Get-ItemProperty -Path $regPath -Name "BootExecute" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

        if (-not $testResult) {
            Write-Host "  $cs\Session Manager\BootExecute: not found, skipping"
            continue
        }

        $currentValue = $testResult.BootExecute

        if (-not $currentValue) {
            Write-Host "  $cs BootExecute: (empty)"
            continue
        }

        # Remove matching entry (case-insensitive)
        $updatedValue = @($currentValue | Where-Object {
            $_ -and
            ($_ -ne $EntryToRemove) -and
            ($_ -notmatch "^\s*$([regex]::Escape($EntryToRemove))\s*$")
        })

        if ($updatedValue.Count -eq @($currentValue).Count) {
            Write-Host "  $cs BootExecute: '$EntryToRemove' not present"
            continue
        }

        # Write updated REG_MULTI_SZ back
        Set-ItemProperty -Path $regPath -Name "BootExecute" -Value $updatedValue
        $foundEntry = $true

        Write-Host "  $cs BootExecute: removed '$EntryToRemove'" -ForegroundColor Green

        # Verify the write
        $verifyValue = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $regPath -Name "BootExecute" -ErrorAction Stop).BootExecute
        Write-Host "  $cs verification: $($verifyValue -join '; ')"
    }

    if (-not $foundEntry) {
        Write-Host "[5/8] '$EntryToRemove' not found in any active ControlSet. No changes needed." -ForegroundColor Green

        # Cleanup: unload hive, unmount with discard
        [gc]::Collect()
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
        $null = & reg unload "HKLM\$HiveName" 2>&1
        $hiveLoaded = $false
        $null = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
        $imageMounted = $false
        if ($mountCreated) { Remove-Item -Path $MountPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
        exit 0
    }

    $changesMade = $true
    Write-Host "[5/8] Removed '$EntryToRemove' from BootExecute" -ForegroundColor Green
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Error modifying BootExecute: $_"

    # Cleanup: unload hive, unmount with discard
    [gc]::Collect()
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    if ($hiveLoaded) {
        $null = & reg unload "HKLM\$HiveName" 2>&1
        $hiveLoaded = $false
    }
    if ($imageMounted) {
        $null = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
        $imageMounted = $false
    }
    exit 1
}

# 6. Unload Offline Registry Hive
# PS Version: All | Admin: Yes | System Requirements: reg.exe
try {
    [gc]::Collect()
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

    $unloadOutput = & reg unload "HKLM\$HiveName" 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Warning "First unload attempt failed, retrying..."
        [gc]::Collect()
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
        $unloadOutput = & reg unload "HKLM\$HiveName" 2>&1
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "[6/8] Unload hive: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Warning "reg unload output: $unloadOutput"
            Write-Host "  Close any Registry Editor windows and retry."

            # Try to unmount with discard to avoid leaving image mounted
            $null = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
            $imageMounted = $false
            exit 1
        }
    }

    $hiveLoaded = $false
    Write-Host "[6/8] Offline hive unloaded" -ForegroundColor Green
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Error unloading hive: $_"

    $null = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
    $imageMounted = $false
    exit 1
}

# 7. Unmount WinRE Image with Commit
# PS Version: All | Admin: Yes | System Requirements: reagentc.exe
try {
    if ($changesMade) {
        $unmountOutput = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /commit 2>&1
    } else {
        $unmountOutput = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
    }

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "[7/8] Unmount WinRE: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
        Write-Warning "reagentc /unmountre output: $unmountOutput"

        # Attempt discard as fallback
        if ($changesMade) {
            Write-Host "  Attempting discard to avoid leaving image in broken state..."
            $null = & reagentc /unmountre /path $MountPath /discard 2>&1
        }
        $imageMounted = $false
        exit 1
    }

    $imageMounted = $false

    if ($changesMade) {
        Write-Host "[7/8] WinRE image unmounted and committed" -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        Write-Host "[7/8] WinRE image unmounted (no changes)" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Error unmounting WinRE image: $_"
    exit 1
}

# 8. Re-seal WinRE (Disable + Enable Cycle for BitLocker Trust Chain)
# PS Version: All | Admin: Yes | System Requirements: reagentc.exe, BitLocker
try {
    if (-not $changesMade) {
        Write-Host "[8/8] Re-seal WinRE: Skipped (no changes made)" -ForegroundColor Green
    } else {
        $disableOutput = & reagentc /disable 2>&1
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Warning "reagentc /disable returned non-zero: $disableOutput"
        } else {
            Write-Host "  WinRE disabled."
        }

        $enableOutput = & reagentc /enable 2>&1
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "[8/8] Re-seal WinRE: FAILED" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Warning "reagentc /enable output: $enableOutput"
            Write-Host "  WinRE may need manual recovery. Run: reagentc /enable"
            exit 1
        }

        Write-Host "[8/8] WinRE re-sealed (disable + enable cycle)" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Error during WinRE re-seal: $_"
    Write-Host "  Run manually: reagentc /enable"
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "  COMPLETE: '$EntryToRemove' removed from WinRE BootExecute" -ForegroundColor Green

# Cleanup: remove mount directory if we created it
if ($mountCreated -and (Test-Path $MountPath)) {
    Remove-Item -Path $MountPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

exit 0

RS-ITQ-da-win-all-Remediate-Language-EN-US 10 settings Intune - Pro Active Remediation
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionThis Proactive Remediation installs and configures the English (United States) language pack (en-US) on supported Windows 11 22H2 and later devices. The script ensures that the English (United States) language pack is installed, configured as the primary display language, and applies the required regional settings. Note: This will need the user to reboot the system itself The remediation performs the following actions on device/system level: Installs the en-US language pack using the Windows LanguagePackManagement module. Configures English (United States) (en-US) as the primary Windows UI language. Sets the system culture and regional format to English (United States). Configures the home location to United States (GeoID 244). Sets the time zone to W. Europe Standard Time. Configures the US-International keyboard layout (00020409) for the English language profile. Copies international settings to the Welcome Screen and new user profiles. Stores the original device language and regional configuration in the registry as a rollback reference. Creates deployment and remediation markers in the registry to support Intune detection, reporting, and user-remediation coordination. Runs only on supported Windows 11 builds (22621 / 22H2 or later). Returns success if the desired configuration is already present, making the remediation fully idempotent. Registry Path Used: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\LanguagePackDeployer Expand
