RS-ITQ-ua-win-all-Remediate-Language-EN-US 10 settings Intune - Pro Active Remediation
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionThis Proactive Remediation aligns the current user's language, regional, and keyboard settings with the English (United States) device language configuration (en-US). The remediation only runs when the device language remediation has successfully completed and the required remediation marker is present in the registry. This ensures that user-specific settings are applied only after the device-wide language configuration has been established. Note: This will need the user to reboot the system itself The remediation performs the following actions: Verifies that the device language remediation marker is present. Configures English (United States) (en-US) as the primary user language. Sets the user culture and regional format to English (United States). Configures the home location to United States (GeoID 244). Configures the English language profile with the US-International keyboard layout (00020409). Sets the Windows UI language override to English (United States). Validates that all user language and regional settings match the device configuration. Remediates only user-scoped settings and does not modify device-wide language settings. Returns success when the desired configuration is already present, making the remediation fully idempotent. Registry Path Used: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\LanguagePackDeployer Expand
Created24/07/2026 13:05:10
Modified24/07/2026 18:08:47
ScopeTags0
Settings
SettingValue
PublisherJeffrey Bouwmeester
Detection Script Content
View script
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Detects the requested language configuration for the current Windows user.
.DESCRIPTION
    Waits for the device (system-context) policy's completion receipt before
    checking the current user's language, culture, keyboard and regional
    settings. Reading the receipt works for standard users, unlike
    Get-InstalledLanguage, and pack presence alone is a false readiness signal:
    in a migration the target pack is often already installed while the device
    settings are not configured yet.
.NOTES
    Product: Language Pack Deployer
    Version: 1.0.0

    Exit codes:
      0    User settings are compliant, or the device policy has not completed
           yet (the user is left untouched until it has)
      1    User remediation is required or detection failed
#>

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# <LanguagePackDeployerConfiguration>
$languages = @(
    @{ Tag = 'en-US'; GeoId = 244; Keyboard = '00020409'; KeyboardName = 'US-International' }
)
$primaryTag = 'en-US'
$deviceConfigurationId = 'cfg-v1-eb1ac170'
# </LanguagePackDeployerConfiguration>

if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432 -eq 'AMD64') {
    $sysnative = "$env:WINDIR\sysnative\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe"
    & $sysnative -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

function Get-KeyboardTip([hashtable]$language) {
    if (-not $language.Keyboard) { return $null }
    $lcidHex = '{0:x4}' -f ([System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo($language.Tag).LCID)
    return "${lcidHex}:$($language.Keyboard)"
}

try {
    Write-Output 'Language Pack Deployer - User detection'
    Write-Output "User: $env:USERNAME"
    Write-Output "Requested languages: $(($languages.Tag) -join ', ')"
    Write-Output "Primary language: $primaryTag"

    # Device handshake: wait for the SYSTEM device policy's completion receipt
    # before evaluating or changing anything in this profile.
    $receipt = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\LanguagePackDeployer\Remediation' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $receipt -or $receipt.Completed -ne 1 -or $receipt.ConfigurationId -ne $deviceConfigurationId) {
        Write-Output '[WAITING] Device completion receipt not found for this configuration.'
        Write-Output 'Result: Compliant - the device (system-context) policy has not completed yet.'
        exit 0
    }
    Write-Output '[PASS] Device completion receipt: present'

    $issues = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
    $languageList = @(Get-WinUserLanguageList)
    $actualPrimaryLanguage = if ($languageList.Count -gt 0) {
    ($languageList.LanguageTag | Select-Object -First 1)
}
else {
    '(none)'
}
    if ($actualPrimaryLanguage -ne $primaryTag) {
        $issues.Add("Primary user language is '$actualPrimaryLanguage'; expected '$primaryTag'")
        Write-Output "[FAIL] Primary user language: $actualPrimaryLanguage (expected: $primaryTag)"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] Primary user language: $actualPrimaryLanguage"
    }

    foreach ($language in $languages) {
        $entry = $languageList | Where-Object { $_.LanguageTag -eq $language.Tag }
        if (-not $entry) {
            $issues.Add("User language is missing: $($language.Tag)")
            Write-Output "[FAIL] User language: $($language.Tag) (missing)"
        }
        else {
            Write-Output "[PASS] User language: $($language.Tag)"
        }
        $tip = Get-KeyboardTip $language
        if ($tip) {
            $keyboardDescription = if ($language.KeyboardName) { "$($language.KeyboardName) ($tip)" } else { $tip }
            if (-not $entry -or $entry.InputMethodTips -notcontains $tip) {
                $issues.Add("Keyboard layout is missing: $keyboardDescription")
                Write-Output "[FAIL] Keyboard layout: $keyboardDescription (missing)"
            }
            else {
                Write-Output "[PASS] Keyboard layout: $keyboardDescription"
            }
        }
    }

    $actualCulture = (Get-Culture).Name
    if ($actualCulture -ne $primaryTag) {
        $issues.Add("User culture is '$actualCulture'; expected '$primaryTag'")
        Write-Output "[FAIL] User culture: $actualCulture (expected: $primaryTag)"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] User culture: $actualCulture"
    }

    $primaryLanguage = $languages | Where-Object { $_.Tag -eq $primaryTag }
    $actualGeoId = (Get-WinHomeLocation).GeoId
    if ($actualGeoId -ne $primaryLanguage.GeoId) {
        $issues.Add("User home location is GeoId '$actualGeoId'; expected '$($primaryLanguage.GeoId)'")
        Write-Output "[FAIL] User home location: GeoId $actualGeoId (expected: $($primaryLanguage.GeoId))"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] User home location: GeoId $actualGeoId"
    }

    $uiOverride = Get-WinUILanguageOverride
    $actualUiOverride = if ($uiOverride) { $uiOverride.Name } else { '(not set)' }
    if ($actualUiOverride -ne $primaryTag) {
        $issues.Add("User UI language override is '$actualUiOverride'; expected '$primaryTag'")
        Write-Output "[FAIL] User UI language override: $actualUiOverride (expected: $primaryTag)"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] User UI language override: $actualUiOverride"
    }

    if ($issues.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Output "Result: Non-compliant ($($issues.Count) issue(s))"
        foreach ($issue in $issues) {
            Write-Output " - $issue"
        }
        exit 1
    }

    Write-Output 'Result: Compliant (all user checks passed)'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-Output "User language configuration detection failed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}
Remediation Script Content
View script
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Configures the requested language settings for the current Windows user.
.DESCRIPTION
    Preserves unrelated user languages while ensuring the requested languages,
    primary language, keyboard, culture, UI override and home location. Runs
    only after the device (system-context) policy has recorded its completion
    receipt, so user profiles are never reconfigured on a half-prepared device.
.NOTES
    Product: Language Pack Deployer
    Version: 1.0.0
    Context: Logged-on user

    A new sign-in can be required before the Windows display language changes.
#>

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# <LanguagePackDeployerConfiguration>
$languages = @(
    @{ Tag = 'en-US'; GeoId = 244; Keyboard = '00020409'; KeyboardName = 'US-International' }
)
$primaryTag = 'en-US'
$deviceConfigurationId = 'cfg-v1-eb1ac170'
# </LanguagePackDeployerConfiguration>

if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432 -eq 'AMD64') {
    $sysnative = "$env:WINDIR\sysnative\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe"
    & $sysnative -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

function Get-KeyboardTip([hashtable]$language) {
    if (-not $language.Keyboard) { return $null }
    $lcidHex = '{0:x4}' -f ([System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo($language.Tag).LCID)
    return "${lcidHex}:$($language.Keyboard)"
}

try {
    Write-Output 'Language Pack Deployer - User remediation'
    Write-Output "User: $env:USERNAME"
    Write-Output "Requested languages: $(($languages.Tag) -join ', ')"
    Write-Output "Primary language: $primaryTag"

    # Device handshake: the SYSTEM device policy records this receipt after
    # installing the language packs and configuring the device. Acting earlier
    # would reconfigure the profile on a half-prepared device.
    $receipt = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\LanguagePackDeployer\Remediation' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $receipt -or $receipt.Completed -ne 1 -or $receipt.ConfigurationId -ne $deviceConfigurationId) {
        Write-Output '[WAITING] Device completion receipt not found for this configuration.'
        Write-Output 'Result: Deferred - the device (system-context) policy has not completed yet.'
        exit 0
    }
    Write-Output '[PASS] Device completion receipt: present'

    $languageList = Get-WinUserLanguageList
    foreach ($language in $languages) {
        if ($languageList.LanguageTag -notcontains $language.Tag) {
            $languageList.Add($language.Tag)
            Write-Output "[CHANGED] Added user language: $($language.Tag)"
        }
        else {
            Write-Output "[PASS] User language already present: $($language.Tag)"
        }
    }

    $primaryEntry = $languageList | Where-Object { $_.LanguageTag -eq $primaryTag }
    if ($languageList[0].LanguageTag -ne $primaryTag) {
        $languageList.Remove($primaryEntry) | Out-Null
        $languageList.Insert(0, $primaryEntry)
        Write-Output "[CHANGED] Set primary user language: $primaryTag"
    }
    else {
        Write-Output "[PASS] Primary user language already set: $primaryTag"
    }

    foreach ($language in $languages) {
        $tip = Get-KeyboardTip $language
        if (-not $tip) { continue }
        $keyboardDescription = if ($language.KeyboardName) { "$($language.KeyboardName) ($tip)" } else { $tip }
        $entry = $languageList | Where-Object { $_.LanguageTag -eq $language.Tag }
        if ($entry.InputMethodTips -notcontains $tip) {
            $entry.InputMethodTips.Clear()
            $entry.InputMethodTips.Add($tip) | Out-Null
            Write-Output "[CHANGED] Set keyboard layout: $keyboardDescription"
        }
        else {
            Write-Output "[PASS] Keyboard layout already present: $keyboardDescription"
        }
    }

    Set-WinUserLanguageList -LanguageList $languageList -Force
    $primaryLanguage = $languages | Where-Object { $_.Tag -eq $primaryTag }
    Set-WinUILanguageOverride -Language $primaryTag
    Set-Culture -CultureInfo $primaryTag
    Set-WinHomeLocation -GeoId $primaryLanguage.GeoId

    Write-Output "[APPLIED] User culture: $primaryTag"
    Write-Output "[APPLIED] User UI language override: $primaryTag"
    Write-Output "[APPLIED] User home location: GeoId $($primaryLanguage.GeoId)"
    Write-Output 'Result: Remediated successfully. A new sign-in can be required for the display language.'
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-Output "User language configuration failed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 1
}

Detection Script Content
View script
<#!
# Detection script to check if Windows Firewall Service is running

Name of the Detection script: PRS-RS-GLOBAL-DG-Default-Detection_Firewall.ps1

.DETAILS
    Creation Date:  2024-09-18
    Updated:        
    Version history:
        1.0.0 - (2024-09-18) Script released
        2.0.0 - (2024-11-11) Script Modified
        2.0.1 - (2024-12-20) Script checked and implemented

Document link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XIy4pCsddw4j-zoAWksm3M_18MAZYW1SAW_wSXiMjMU/edit

#>

# Check if Windows Defender Firewall service is running
$firewallService = Get-Service -Name "MpsSvc" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

if ($firewallService -eq $null) {
    Write-Host "Windows Defender Firewall service is not running."
    exit 1
}

# Check the status of Firewall profiles
$domainProfile = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Domain"
$privateProfile = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Private"
$publicProfile = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Public"

$allProfilesEnabled = $domainProfile.Enabled -and $privateProfile.Enabled -and $publicProfile.Enabled

if ($allProfilesEnabled) {
    Write-Host "Firewall and all Firewall Profiles (Domain, Private, Public) are enabled."
    exit 0
} else {
    Write-Host "One or more Firewall Profiles (Domain, Private, Public) are disabled."
    exit 1
}
Remediation Script Content
View script
<#!
# Remediation script to start Windows Firewall Service.

Name of the Detection script: PRS-RS-GLOBAL-DG-Default-Remediation_Firewall.ps1

.DETAILS
    Creation Date:  2024-09-18
    Updated:        
    Version history:
        1.0.0 - (2024-09-18) Script released
        2.0.0 - (2024-11-11) Script Modified
        2.0.1 - (2024-12-20) Script checked and implemented

Document link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XIy4pCsddw4j-zoAWksm3M_18MAZYW1SAW_wSXiMjMU/edit

#>


# Check if Windows Defender Firewall service is running and start if necessary
$firewallService = Get-Service -Name "MpsSvc" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

if ($firewallService -eq $null -or $firewallService.Status -ne "Running") {
    Write-Host "Windows Defender Firewall service is not running or not in a running state. Attempting to start..."
    
    Start-Service -Name "MpsSvc" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 5  # Wait a few seconds for service to start
    
    # Check service status after attempting to start
    $firewallService = Get-Service -Name "MpsSvc" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($firewallService -eq $null -or $firewallService.Status -ne "Running") {
        Write-Host "Failed to start Windows Defender Firewall service. Exiting remediation."
        exit 1
    } else {
        Write-Host "Windows Defender Firewall service started successfully."
    }
}

# Check the status of Firewall profiles
$domainProfile = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Domain"
$privateProfile = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Private"
$publicProfile = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Public"

$allProfilesEnabled = $domainProfile.Enabled -and $privateProfile.Enabled -and $publicProfile.Enabled

if ($allProfilesEnabled) {
    Write-Host "Firewall Profiles (Domain, Private, Public) are enabled."
    exit 0
} else {
    Write-Host "One or more Firewall Profiles (Domain, Private, Public) are disabled. Initiating remediation..."

    # Enable all Firewall profiles
    $domainProfile | Set-NetFirewallProfile -Enabled True
    $privateProfile | Set-NetFirewallProfile -Enabled True
    $publicProfile | Set-NetFirewallProfile -Enabled True
    
    # Verify profiles after remediation
    $domainProfileAfter = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Domain"
    $privateProfileAfter = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Private"
    $publicProfileAfter = Get-NetFirewallProfile -Name "Public"

    $allProfilesEnabledAfter = $domainProfileAfter.Enabled -and $privateProfileAfter.Enabled -and $publicProfileAfter.Enabled

    if ($allProfilesEnabledAfter) {
        Write-Host "Successfully remediated: Firewall and all Firewall Profiles are now enabled."
        exit 0
    } else {
        Write-Host "Failed to remediate: Firewall or one or more Firewall Profiles are still disabled."
        exit 1
    }
}

Detection Script Content
View script
﻿<#

.DESCRIPTION
    The script uses the netsh http show urlacl cmdlet to get the status of the "http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/" entry. If the entry exist, check if user /everyone is set to it. If so the script exits with a status code of 1, else no remediation is needed.

.NOTES
    Filename: PRS-BASE-UG-Default-Remediation_urlaclTemporaryListenAddresses-detection.ps1
    Version: 1.0
    Author : Chris Koopman

    Microsoft docymentation : https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/wcf/feature-details/how-to-replace-the-wcf-url-reservation-with-a-restricted-reservation

#>
# Get the state urlacl for http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/
try {
    # Define the reserved URL
    $reservedUrl = "http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/"

    # Get URL reservations as an array of lines
    $urlAcls = netsh http show urlacl

    # Find the line index where the reserved URL appears
    $index = -1
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $urlAcls.Count; $i++) {
         if ($urlAcls[$i] -like "*$reservedUrl*") {
             $index = $i
             break
             }
        }
    if ($index -ge 0) {
    # Parse lines starting from the reserved URL
    for ($j = $index; $j -lt $urlAcls.Count; $j++) {
        $line = $urlAcls[$j]

        if ($line -match "^\s*User\s*:\s*(.+)$") {
            $user = $Matches[1].Trim()
            if ($user -eq "\Everyone") {
                Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists and is assigned to '\Everyone'."
                exit 1
            } else {
                Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists but is assigned to '$user'."
                exit 0
            }
            break
        }

        # Stop if another reservation block begins
        if ($j -ne $index -and $line -like "Reserved URL*") {
            Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists but no User assignment was found."
            exit 0
        }
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' does not exist."
    exit 0
}



    } catch {
    Write-Error "Failed to get the state netsh http show urlacl"
    exit 1

﻿<#
.SYNOPSIS
    This script remove the urlacl for http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/ if it is applied to /everyone on the system.

.DESCRIPTION
    The script uses the netsh http show urlacl cmdlet to get the status of the "http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/" entry. If the entry exist, check if user /everyone is set to it. If so the script exits with a status code of 1, else no remediation is needed.

.NOTES
    Filename: PRS-BASE-UG-Default-Remediation_urlaclTemporaryListenAddresses-remediation.ps1
    Version: 1.0
    Author : Chris Koopman
    
    Sheet with all normal / default windows settings: URL Reservations Intune default settings.xlsx

    Microsoft docymentation : https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/wcf/feature-details/how-to-replace-the-wcf-url-reservation-with-a-restricted-reservation

#>
# Get the state urlacl for http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/
try {
    # Define the reserved URL
    $reservedUrl = "http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/"

    # Get URL reservations as an array of lines
    $urlAcls = netsh http show urlacl

    # Find the line index where the reserved URL appears
    $index = -1
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $urlAcls.Count; $i++) {
         if ($urlAcls[$i] -like "*$reservedUrl*") {
             $index = $i
             break
             }
        }
    if ($index -ge 0) {
    # Found the reserved URL, try to remove it
    Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists. Attempting to remove it..."
    
    $removeResult = netsh http delete urlacl url=$reservedUrl 2>&1

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "Successfully removed the reserved URL."
    } else {
        Write-Host "Failed to remove the reserved URL. Output:"
        Write-Host $removeResult
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' does not exist. Nothing to remove."
}



    } catch {
    Write-Error "Failed to get the state netsh http show urlacl"
    exit 1
}

﻿<#
.SYNOPSIS
    This script checks if urlacl for http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/ is applied to /everyone on the system.

.DESCRIPTION
    The script uses the netsh http show urlacl cmdlet to get the status of the "http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/" entry. If the entry NOT exist, the script exits with a status code of 1, so remediation is needed.

.NOTES
    Filename: PRS-BASE-UG-Default-Remediation_urlaclTemporaryListenAddresses-add-detection.ps1
    Version: 1.0
    Author : Chris Koopman
    
    Sheet with all normal / default windows settings: URL Reservations Intune default settings.xlsx

    Microsoft docymentation : https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/wcf/feature-details/how-to-replace-the-wcf-url-reservation-with-a-restricted-reservation

#>
# Get the state urlacl for http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/
try {
    # Define the reserved URL
    $reservedUrl = "http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/"

    # Get URL reservations as an array of lines
    $urlAcls = netsh http show urlacl

    # Find the line index where the reserved URL appears
    $index = -1
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $urlAcls.Count; $i++) {
         if ($urlAcls[$i] -like "*$reservedUrl*") {
             $index = $i
             break
             }
        }
    if ($index -ge 0) {
    # Parse lines starting from the reserved URL
    for ($j = $index; $j -lt $urlAcls.Count; $j++) {
        $line = $urlAcls[$j]

        if ($line -match "^\s*User\s*:\s*(.+)$") {
            $user = $Matches[1].Trim()
            if ($user -eq "\Everyone") {
                Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists and is assigned to '\Everyone'."
                exit 0
            } else {
                Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists but is assigned to '$user'."
                exit 1
            }
            break
        }

        # Stop if another reservation block begins
        if ($j -ne $index -and $line -like "Reserved URL*") {
            Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists but no User assignment was found."
            exit 1
        }
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' does not exist."
    exit 1
}



    } catch {
    Write-Error "Failed to get the state netsh http show urlacl"
    exit 0
}

﻿<#
.SYNOPSIS
    This script add the urlacl for http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/ to /everyone on the system, this is the windows default, but removed to become compliant to Gloabl security requirements. 
    https://global-jira.randstadservices.com/browse/GWNL-1039

.DESCRIPTION
    The script uses the netsh http show urlacl cmdlet to get the status of the "http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/" entry. If the entry NOT exist, the script adds the line.

.NOTES
    Filename: PRS-BASE-UG-Default-Remediation_urlaclTemporaryListenAddresses-add-remediation.ps1
    Version: 1.0
    Author : Chris Koopman
    

    Microsoft docymentation : https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/wcf/feature-details/how-to-replace-the-wcf-url-reservation-with-a-restricted-reservation

#>
# Set the default state urlacl for http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/
try {
    # Define the reserved URL
    $reservedUrl = "http://+:80/Temporary_Listen_Addresses/"
    $userGroup = "Everyone"

    # Get URL reservations as an array of lines
    $urlAcls = netsh http show urlacl

    # Find the line index where the reserved URL appears
    $index = -1
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $urlAcls.Count; $i++) {
        if ($urlAcls[$i] -like "*$reservedUrl*") {
            $index = $i
            break
        }
    }

    if ($index -ge 0) {
        # Parse lines starting from the reserved URL
        for ($j = $index; $j -lt $urlAcls.Count; $j++) {
            $line = $urlAcls[$j]

            if ($line -match "^\s*User\s*:\s*(.+)$") {
                $user = $Matches[1].Trim()
                if ($user -eq "\Everyone") {
                    Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists and is assigned to '\Everyone'."
                    exit 1
                } else {
                    Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists but is assigned to '$user'."
                    exit 0
                }
            }

            # Stop if another reservation block begins
            if ($j -ne $index -and $line -like "Reserved URL*") {
                Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' exists but no User assignment was found."
                exit 0
            }
        }
    } else {
        Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' does not exist. Adding it..."

        # Add the reservation
        $addCommand = "netsh http add urlacl url=$reservedUrl user=$userGroup"
        Invoke-Expression $addCommand

        Write-Host "The reserved URL '$reservedUrl' was successfully added for user '$userGroup'."
        exit 0
    }

} catch {
    Write-Error "Failed to get or set the state of netsh http show urlacl"
    exit 1
}

# Define Variables

try {
    $gpResult = [datetime]::FromFileTime(([Int64] ((Get-ItemProperty -Path "Registry::HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Group Policy\State\Machine\Extension-List\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}").startTimeHi) -shl 32) -bor ((Get-ItemProperty -Path "Registry::HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Group Policy\State\Machine\Extension-List\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}").startTimeLo))
    $lastGPUpdateDate = Get-Date ($gpResult[0])
    [int]$lastGPUpdateDays = (New-TimeSpan -Start $lastGPUpdateDate -End (Get-Date)).Days
        
    if ($lastGPUpdateDays -gt 7){
        #Exit 1 for Intune. We want it to be within the last 7 days "Match" to remediate in SCCM
        Write-Host "Match"
        exit 1
    }
    else {
        #Exit 0 for Intune and "No_Match" for SCCM, only remediate "Match"
        Write-Host "No_Match"            
        exit 0
    }
}
catch {
    $errMsg = $_.Exception.Message
    return $errMsg
    exit 1
}

Remediation Script Content
View script
# Define Variables

try {
    $compGPUpd = gpupdate /force
    $gpResult = [datetime]::FromFileTime(([Int64] ((Get-ItemProperty -Path "Registry::HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Group Policy\State\Machine\Extension-List\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}").startTimeHi) -shl 32) -bor ((Get-ItemProperty -Path "Registry::HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Group Policy\State\Machine\Extension-List\{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}").startTimeLo))
    $lastGPUpdateDate = Get-Date ($gpResult[0])
    [int]$lastGPUpdateDays = (New-TimeSpan -Start $lastGPUpdateDate -End (Get-Date)).Days

    if ($lastGPUpdateDays -eq 0){        
        Write-Host "gpupdate completed successfully"            
        exit 0
    }
    else{
        Write-Host "gpupdate failed"
        }
}
catch{
    $errMsg = $_.Exception.Message
    return $errMsg
    exit 1
}

ITQ-ua-protapp-mdm-ios-lv1 270 settings
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionLevel 1 is the minimum data protection configuration for a managed enterprise mobile device. It ensures basic enterprise data protection through encryption requirements and PIN-based access, while relying on the underlying MDM Compliance Policy for device-level controls such as jailbreak detection and minimum OS version. This level is suitable as a starting point for organizations beginning their data protection journey, with minimal impact on user experience and application functionality.Expand

ITQ-ua-protapp-mdm-ios-lv2 99 settings
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionLevel 2 is the data protection configuration recommended as a standard for managed devices where users access more sensitive information. These devices are a natural target in enterprises today. This level restricts org data sharing and storage to policy managed applications, blocks screen capture and Writing Tools, and forces web content to open in Microsoft Edge. Org data notifications and third-party keyboards remain allowed, as the device is corporate-owned and already subject to MDM compliance controls. These recommendations don't assume a large staff of highly skilled security practitioners, and therefore should be accessible to most enterprise organizations.Expand

ITQ-ua-protapp-mdm-ios-lv3 99 settings
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionLevel 3 is the data protection configuration recommended for managed devices that access highly sensitive or confidential organizational data. This level builds on Level 2 by introducing the most restrictive controls available within the framework, including blocking incoming data and cut/copy/paste to policy managed apps only, blocking opening of org data into other documents, requiring work or school account credentials for access, disabling Genmoji, blocking org data notifications, and blocking sync with native apps and add-ins. Printing of org data is fully blocked and the minimum PIN length is increased. This level is intended for organizations with a mature security posture and elevated compliance requirements, where maximum data protection takes priority over user convenience.Expand

DescriptionThis policy removes the FileVault encryption key from memory when a macOS device enters sleep mode. Users will be required to re-authenticate when the device wakes, ensuring the encryption key is reloaded securely. This setting provides additional protection against physical and memory-based attacks and is aligned with enhanced security hardening practices commonly associated with CIS Level 2 recommendations. Due to the potential impact on user experience, it is deployed as an optional hardening control rather than part of the standard macOS baseline.Expand

PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-FileVault-Escrow-Buddy 10 settings
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionDownloads and installs Escrow Buddy (https://github.com/macadmins/escrow-buddy), an open-source SecurityAgent plugin maintained by the Mac Admins community. Closes a known FileVault gap: when a user resets their FileVault password, macOS generates a new personal recovery key locally but does not re-escrow it to Intune. Escrow Buddy patches the macOS authorization database so the new key is re-escrowed at next login. Idempotent; verifies version against the GitHub releases API and only re-installs when needed. Pairs with mac-security-d-filevault.json (FileVault enforcement). Fleet-wide; no Tier element.Expand
Created04/08/2026 10:23:13
Modified12/08/2026 12:27:34
ScopeTags1
Settings
SettingValue
Additional Data—
Execution Frequency1.00:00:00
Retry Count3
Block Execution NotificationsTrue

#!/bin/bash
#set -x

# Script Name: installEB.sh
# Description: This script downloads and installs the latest release of Escrow Buddy, a security agent plugin for macOS. 
#              The script checks if the log directory has been created and creates it if necessary. 
#              It also defines several functions for downloading and updating Escrow Buddy, as well as checking if the Escrow Buddy authorizationdb entry is configured. 
#              The logger function is used to log messages to stdout and a log file.
# Version: 1.0.2
# Author: Tobias Almén
# Date: 2024-06-14

# Manual version override
version="" # Only configure this if you want to control the version of Escrow Buddy that is installed, otherwise leave it blank. Example: version="1.0.0"

# Set the path to the installed Escrow Buddy bundle
install_path="/Library/Security/SecurityAgentPlugins/Escrow Buddy.bundle"
# Set the path to the log directory
logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/EscrowBuddy"
# File to store last updatedtime
lastupdated="$logandmetadir/lastupdated"
# Set the API URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy
eb_url="https://api.github.com/repos/macadmins/escrow-buddy/releases/latest"
# Set the path to the installed Escrow Buddy bundle
install_path="/Library/Security/SecurityAgentPlugins/Escrow Buddy.bundle"
# Curl the API URL for the latest release and download url of Escrow Buddy
response=$(curl --silent "$eb_url")
# Get the latest release of Escrow Buddy
latest_release=$(echo "$response" | grep -o '"tag_name": "[^"]*' | grep -o '[^"]*$')
# Get the numerical version of the latest release of Escrow Buddy
latest_version=$(echo "$latest_release" | cut -c 2-)
# Get FDE status
FDE_STATUS=$(fdesetup status)
# Get FDE profile status
FDE_PROFILE="/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.security.FDERecoveryKeyEscrow.plist"
# Path to FileVaultPRK
PRK="/var/db/FileVaultPRK.dat"

## Check if the log directory has been created
if [ -d $logandmetadir ]; then
	## Already created
	echo "[$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")] [INFO] Log directory already exists - $logandmetadir"
else
	## Creating Metadirectory
	echo "[$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")] [INFO] creating log directory - $logandmetadir"
	mkdir -p $logandmetadir
fi

# Function to log messages to stdout
function logger() {
    # Function to log messages to stdout and a log file
    #
    # Arguments:
    #   $1: The log level (e.g. INFO, WARNING, ERROR)
    #   $2: The message to log

    level=$1
    message=$2

    # Log the message with the current date and time and the specified log level
    date=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
    echo "[$date] [$level] $message"
    echo "[$date] [$level] $message" >> "$logandmetadir/installeb.log"
}

function remediate() {
    # Function to remediate missing FV key
    #
    # Arguments:
    #   None
    # Returns:
    #   None
    # Variables:
    #   $FDE_STATUS: The status of FileVault
    #   $FDE_PROFILE: FDE profile path
    #   $PRK: The path to the FileVaultPRK

    # If FileVault is not enabled, exit
    if [ "FileVault is On." != "$FDE_STATUS" ]; then
        exit 0
    fi

    # If the escrow plist exists, check for the recovery key file
    if [ -f "$FDE_PROFILE" ]; then
        # If the key has been escrowed, exit
        if [ -f "$PRK" ]; then
            logger "INFO" "Key has been escrowed"
        # If the key has not been escrowed, set GenerateNewKey to true
        else
            logger "INFO" "Key has not been escrowed"
            defaults write /Library/Preferences/com.netflix.Escrow-Buddy.plist GenerateNewKey -bool true
        fi
    # If the escrow plist does not exist, do nothing
    else
        logger "INFO" "No FileVault profile has been applied"
    fi
}

function getVersion() {
    # Convert a version string in the format x.y.z.w to an integer
    # Nabbed from Matt's WS1 example and slightly modified
    #
    # Arguments:
    #   $1: The version string to convert
    # Returns:
    #   The integer representation of the version string
    # Variables:
    #   None

    echo "$1" | awk -F. '{ printf("%d%d%d%d\n", $1,$2,$3,$4); }'
}

# Function to download the latest release of Escrow Buddy
function downloadEscrowBuddy() {
    # Download the latest release of Escrow Buddy
    #
    # Arguments:
    #   None
    # Returns:
    #   None
    # Variables:
    #   $response: The response from the API URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy
    #   $download_url: The download URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy

    # Get the download URL for the latest release
    download_url=$(echo "$response" | grep -o '"browser_download_url": "[^"]*' | grep -o '[^"]*$' | grep -i '\.pkg$')

    # Download the latest release of Escrow Buddy
    logger "INFO" "Downloading Escrow Buddy $latest_release"
    curl -L -s "$download_url" -o "/tmp/Escrow.Buddy.pkg"

    # Check if the download was successful
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        logger "INFO" "Escrow Buddy $latest_release downloaded successfully"
    else
        logger "ERROR" "Escrow Buddy $latest_release download failed"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Function to update Escrow Buddy if a new version is available
function updateEscrowBuddy() {
    # Update Escrow Buddy if a new version is available
    #
    # Arguments:
    #   input_version: The highest version of Escrow Buddy to install
    # Returns:
    #   None
    # Variables:
    #   $response: The response from the API URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy
    #   $download_url: The download URL for the latest release of Escrow Buddy
    #   $lastmodified: The last modified date of the latest release of Escrow Buddy
    #   $previouslastmodifieddate: The last modified date of the previously installed release of Escrow Buddy
    #   $lastupdated: The path to the file containing the last modified date of the previously installed release of Escrow Buddy

    # Manual version override
    input_version=$1

    # If the input version is set, check if an update is available
    if [ "$input_version" ]; then 
        # Check if Escrow Buddy is installed
        if [ -d "$install_path" ]; then
            # If the input version is not the same as the latest version, log a warning
            if [ $(getVersion $input_version) != $(getVersion $latest_version) ]; then
                logger "WARNING" "Input version [$input_version] does not match latest version [$latest_version]"
            # If the input version and the latest version are the same, check if an update is available
            else
                # Get the version of the currently installed release of Escrow Buddy
                installed_version=$(defaults read "$install_path"/Contents/Info.plist CFBundleShortVersionString)
                if [ $(getVersion $input_version) -gt $(getVersion $installed_version) ]; then
                    logger "INFO" "Update found, input version [$input_version] and current [$installed_version]"
                    # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy
                    installEscrowBuddy
                else
                    logger "INFO" "No update found, input version [$input_version] and current [$installed_version]"
                fi
            fi
        else
            logger "INFO" "Unable to check for updates, Escrow Buddy is not installed, installing"
            # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy
            installEscrowBuddy
        fi

    else
        # Get the download URL for the latest release
        download_url=$(echo "$response" | grep -o '"browser_download_url": "[^"]*' | grep -o '[^"]*$' | grep -i '\.pkg$')
        # Get the last modified date for the latest release
        lastmodified=$(curl -sIL "$download_url" | grep -i "last-modified" | awk '{$1=""; print $0}' | awk '{ sub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print }' | tr -d '\r')

        # Check if the last modified date of the latest release is different to the last modified date of the previously installed release
        if [ -f "$lastupdated" ]; then
            previouslastmodifieddate=$(cat "$lastupdated")
            if [[ "$previouslastmodifieddate" != "$lastmodified" ]]; then
                logger "INFO" "Update found, previous [$previouslastmodifieddate] and current [$lastmodified]"

                # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy
                installEscrowBuddy
            # If the last modified date of the latest release is the same as the last modified date of the previously installed release, do nothing
            else
                logger "INFO" "No update between previous [$previouslastmodifieddate] and current [$lastmodified]"
            fi

        # If the last modified date of the previously installed release is not found, install the latest release of Escrow Buddy
        else
            logger "INFO" "Meta file [$lastupdated] not found"
            logger "INFO" "Unable to determine if update required so updating anyway"

            # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy
            installEscrowBuddy

        fi

    fi

}

# Function to install Escrow Buddy
function installEscrowBuddy() {
    # Install the latest release of Escrow Buddy
    #
    # Arguments:
    #   None
    # Returns:
    #   None
    # Variables:
    #   None

    # Install Escrow Buddy
    downloadEscrowBuddy
    logger "INFO" "Installing Escrow Buddy"
    sudo installer -pkg "/tmp/Escrow.Buddy.pkg" -target "/" > /dev/null 2>&1
    exitcode=$?

    # Clean up
    rm -f "/tmp/Escrow.Buddy.pkg"

    # Check if the installation was successful
    if [ $exitcode -eq 0 ]; then
        logger "INFO" "Escrow Buddy installed successfully"
        lastmodified=$(curl -sIL "$download_url" | grep -i "last-modified" | awk '{$1=""; print $0}' | awk '{ sub(/^[ \t]+/, ""); print }' | tr -d '\r')
        logger "INFO" "Writing last update information to [$lastupdated]"
        echo $lastmodified >"$lastupdated"
    else
        logger "ERROR" "Escrow Buddy installation failed"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Check if Escrow Buddy is already installed
if [ -d "$install_path" ]; then
    # If Escrow Buddy is already installed, check if an update is required
    logger "INFO" "Escrow Buddy already installed, checking for update" 
    updateEscrowBuddy $version
else
    # If Escrow Buddy is not installed, install it
    logger "INFO" "Escrow Buddy not installed, installing" 
    installEscrowBuddy
fi

# Check if Escrow Buddy authorizationdb entry is configured
"$install_path"/Contents/Resources/AuthDBSetup.sh | while read line; do
    logger "INFO" "$line"
done

# Run remediation
remediate

#!/bin/zsh
# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# Licensed under the MIT License.
set -e

############################################################################################
## Install Company Portal for Platform SSO (PSSO) during Setup Assistant
## Maintainer: neiljohn@microsoft.com
##
## Summary: Lightweight Company Portal installer designed to run during macOS Setup
##          Assistant for Platform SSO enrollment. Unlike the standard install script, this
##          variant skips Rosetta 2 checks, desktop readiness waits, and update checks
##          since it runs before the user reaches the desktop and Company Portal will not
##          yet be installed.
##
## Usage:   Deploy via Intune as a shell script assigned to run during Setup Assistant.
##          This ensures Company Portal is available for PSSO registration before the
##          user first logs in.
##
## Exit codes: 0 success, 1 failure.
############################################################################################

## Scripts are not supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service. The scripts are provided AS IS without warranty of any kind.
## Microsoft disclaims all implied warranties including, without limitation, any implied warranties of merchantability or of fitness for a
## particular purpose. The entire risk arising out of the use or performance of the scripts and documentation remains with you. In no event shall
## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever
## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary
## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility
## of such damages.
## Feedback: neiljohn@microsoft.com

## Config
weburl="https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=853070"
logdir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/installCompanyPortalPSSO"
pkg=$(mktemp -t CompanyPortal).pkg

mkdir -p "$logdir"
exec > >(tee -a "$logdir/CompanyPortal.log") 2>&1
trap 'rm -f "$pkg"' EXIT

echo "$(date) | Starting PSSO Setup Assistant install of Company Portal"

curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --retry 5 --retry-delay 60 -o "$pkg" "$weburl"
installer -pkg "$pkg" -target /

#!/bin/bash
# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# Licensed under the MIT License.
#set -x
############################################################################################
##
## Script to enable the Finder Sync extension for OneDrive
##
## Recommended Intune settings:
##   - Run script as signed-in user : No   (script handles user-context invocation itself)
##   - Hide script notifications on devices : Yes
##   - Script frequency : Not configured
##   - Number of times to retry if script fails : 3
##
## Notes:
##   When this script is run from an MDM / launchd context (e.g. by the Intune agent),
##   pluginkit invoked directly will return:
##       "match: connection invalid"
##   ...because the process is not attached to the user's Aqua GUI launchd bootstrap.
##   The fix is to re-enter the user's session with `launchctl asuser <uid>` so that
##   pluginkit can talk to the per-user pluginkit / extensionkit endpoints.
##   See: https://github.com/microsoft/shell-intune-samples/issues/137
##        https://github.com/microsoft/shell-intune-samples/issues/148
##
############################################################################################

## Scripts are not supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service. The scripts are provided AS IS without warranty of any kind.
## Microsoft disclaims all implied warranties including, without limitation, any implied warranties of merchantability or of fitness for a
## particular purpose. The entire risk arising out of the use or performance of the scripts and documentation remains with you. In no event shall
## Microsoft, its authors, or anyone else involved in the creation, production, or delivery of the scripts be liable for any damages whatsoever
## (including, without limitation, damages for loss of business profits, business interruption, loss of business information, or other pecuniary
## loss) arising out of the use of or inability to use the sample scripts or documentation, even if Microsoft has been advised of the possibility
## of such damages.
## Feedback: neiljohn@microsoft.com

appname="EnableOneDriveFinderSync"
application="/Applications/OneDrive.app"

# Identify the active console user (works regardless of whether this script is
# invoked as root by the Intune agent or as the signed-in user).
currentUser=$(/usr/bin/stat -f%Su /dev/console)
if [[ -z "$currentUser" || "$currentUser" == "root" || "$currentUser" == "_mbsetupuser" || "$currentUser" == "loginwindow" ]]; then
    echo "$(date) | No real console user logged in (got '$currentUser'); nothing to do."
    exit 0
fi
uid=$(/usr/bin/id -u "$currentUser")

# Log to the same location as the Device Rename scripts.
logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/IntuneLogs"
log="$logandmetadir/$appname.log"

# Make sure the log directory exists.
if [[ ! -d "$logandmetadir" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$logandmetadir"
fi

# Start logging
exec &> >(tee -a "$log")

echo ""
echo "##############################################################"
echo "# $(date) | Starting $appname"
echo "##############################################################"
echo "$(date) | Console user : $currentUser ($uid)"
echo "$(date) | Running as   : $(/usr/bin/id -un) ($(/usr/bin/id -u))"

# Helper: run a command inside the console user's GUI launchd session so that
# pluginkit attaches to the per-user pluginkit endpoints.
runAsUser() {
    /bin/launchctl asuser "$uid" /usr/bin/sudo -u "$currentUser" "$@"
}

# Wait for OneDrive to be installed (cap the wait so the agent doesn't hang forever)
attempts=0
while [[ ! -d "$application" && $attempts -lt 30 ]]; do
    echo "$(date) | $application not installed yet, waiting 60s (attempt $((attempts+1))/30)"
    sleep 60
    attempts=$((attempts+1))
done

if [[ ! -d "$application" ]]; then
    echo "$(date) | OneDrive still not installed after waiting; exiting."
    exit 1
fi
echo "$(date) | $application found"

# Discover the installed extension ID (differs between standalone and VPP/Mac App Store).
echo "$(date) | Looking for an installed OneDrive Finder Sync extension"
matchOutput=$(runAsUser /usr/bin/pluginkit -m -i com.microsoft.OneDrive.FinderSync 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -n "$matchOutput" ]]; then
    extensionname="com.microsoft.OneDrive.FinderSync"
    echo "$(date) | Found standalone extension: $extensionname"
else
    matchOutput=$(runAsUser /usr/bin/pluginkit -m -i com.microsoft.OneDrive-mac.FinderSync 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ -n "$matchOutput" ]]; then
        extensionname="com.microsoft.OneDrive-mac.FinderSync"
        echo "$(date) | Found VPP / Mac App Store extension: $extensionname"
    fi
fi

if [[ -z "${extensionname:-}" ]]; then
    echo "$(date) | No OneDrive Finder Sync extension registered yet; exiting so the script can retry on the next run."
    exit 1
fi

# Already enabled?
status=$(runAsUser /usr/bin/pluginkit -m -i "$extensionname" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$(date) | Current status: ${status:-<empty>}"
if [[ "$status" == +* ]]; then
    echo "$(date) | $extensionname is already enabled; nothing to do."
    exit 0
fi

# Enable the extension inside the user's GUI session so we don't get
# "match: connection invalid".
echo "$(date) | Enabling $extensionname for $currentUser"
runAsUser /usr/bin/pluginkit -e use -i "$extensionname"
rc=$?

# Verify
status=$(runAsUser /usr/bin/pluginkit -m -i "$extensionname" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$(date) | Post-enable status: ${status:-<empty>}"

if [[ $rc -eq 0 && "$status" == +* ]]; then
    echo "$(date) | $appname completed successfully"
    exit 0
else
    echo "$(date) | $appname failed to enable extension (rc=$rc)"
    exit 1
fi

PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-OneDrive-Open-At-Login 10 settings
Basics
PropertyValue
DescriptionEnables the OneDrive login item so OneDrive launches automatically at login for the signed-in user. The legacy `OpenAtLogin` preference (in mac-experience-d-onedrive.json) is deprecated since sync app 24.113 and a no-op on current builds; a Managed Login Items profile (team-ID UBF8T346G9 in mac-system-d-login-items.json) can only *allow* a login item, not *enable* it. Microsoft's `/createloginitem` fire-and-exit command (OneDrive 26.027+) is the only mechanism that enables it - verified on-device 2026-07-13: flipped the OneDriveLauncher BTM item [disabled] -> [enabled, allowed], persisted across reboot. MUST run as the signed-in user (open -a fails outside the user's Aqua session). Guarded + idempotent: no-ops until OneDrive.app is present and >= 26.027; Intune retries every 15 min, and a per-user marker (~/Library/Application Support/Inforcer/onedrive-loginitem.done) makes it run the enable once then no-op, so the cadence never re-launches OneDrive. OneDrive need NOT be a required app: it self-heals whenever OneDrive lands by any means, and no-ops (exit 0, logged) when absent. Does NOT remove the one-time first-run sign-in / File Provider consent. Fleet-wide; no Tier element.Expand

#!/bin/zsh
#
# macOS - Experience - D - OneDrive Open At Login
# -----------------------------------------------
# Registers (enables) the OneDrive login item so OneDrive starts automatically
# at login for the signed-in user.
#
# Why a script and not a profile:
#   * The legacy OneDrive `OpenAtLogin` preference is DEPRECATED as of sync app
#     24.113 and is a no-op on current builds.
#   * A com.apple.servicemanagement (Managed Login Items) profile can only
#     *allow* / lock a login item (we ship a team-ID UBF8T346G9 allow rule in
#     mac-system-d-login-items.json) - per Apple it does NOT *enable* one.
#   * Microsoft's `/createloginitem` command (OneDrive 26.027+) performs the
#     enable. Verified on-device: flips the OneDriveLauncher BTM item from
#     [disabled] -> [enabled, allowed] and persists across reboot.
#
# Deployment (Intune > Devices > macOS > Shell scripts):
#   * Run script as signed-in user = YES   (open -a fails outside the user's
#     Aqua/GUI session - confirmed on-device as MacLAPS: "Unable to find
#     application named 'OneDrive'")
#   * Execution frequency = every 15 min; retries = 3
# Guarded + idempotent: no-ops until OneDrive is present and >= MINVER, runs the
# enable exactly once (marker guard, Guard 0), then goes quiet. OneDrive need NOT
# be a managed/required app - it self-heals whenever OneDrive lands, by any means.

set -u
ONEDRIVE="/Applications/OneDrive.app"
MINVER="26.027"   # first OneDrive build supporting /createloginitem
MARKER="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Inforcer/onedrive-loginitem.done"

log() { echo "[onedrive-openatlogin] $*"; }

# Guard 0 - already registered on this account. Checked first, so the steady
# state (every 15-min run after success) is a cheap no-op that never re-launches
# OneDrive. ponytail: marker means "we asked OneDrive to register", not "BTM
# verified" - BTM read needs root and this runs as the user. Upgrade path: a
# root-context companion reading `sfltool dumpbtm` if we ever need true assertion.
# To force a re-run, delete the marker file.
if [[ -f "$MARKER" ]]; then
  log "Login item already registered (marker present) - no-op."
  exit 0
fi

# Guard 1 - do nothing until OneDrive is actually installed (handles the
# enrolment race where the app install lags this script). open -a on a missing
# app is meaningless, so no-op and let the daily schedule catch up.
if [[ ! -d "$ONEDRIVE" ]]; then
  log "OneDrive not installed yet - no-op; will retry next run."
  exit 0
fi

# Guard 2 - /createloginitem needs OneDrive >= 26.027. Older builds still honour
# the OpenAtLogin managed pref, so just no-op rather than launching the full app.
ver=$(defaults read "$ONEDRIVE/Contents/Info" CFBundleShortVersionString 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
ok=$(awk -v v="$ver" -v m="$MINVER" 'BEGIN{split(v,a,".");split(m,b,".");print (a[1]*100000+a[2] >= b[1]*100000+b[2])?1:0}')
if [[ "$ok" != "1" ]]; then
  log "OneDrive $ver < $MINVER - /createloginitem unavailable; relying on OpenAtLogin pref. No-op."
  exit 0
fi

# Enable the OneDrive login item. Fire-and-exit; does not launch the full sync
# client. Then drop the marker so Guard 0 no-ops every subsequent run.
open -a "$ONEDRIVE" --args /createloginitem
mkdir -p "${MARKER:h}"
print -r -- "registered OneDrive $ver at login" > "$MARKER"
log "Requested OneDrive login-item registration (OneDrive $ver); marker written."
exit 0

PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-Platform-SSO-AutoFill 10 settings
Basics

DescriptionVerifies Platform SSO registration and enables the Company Portal AutoFill credential-provider extension (com.microsoft.CompanyPortalMac.Mac-Autofill-Extension) via `pluginkit -e use -i`. Intune Settings Catalog has no MDM key to pre-approve macOS credential providers, so without this script every user has to flip the toggle in System Settings -> General -> AutoFill & Passwords manually after PSSO registers — the documented friction point in Microsoft's PSSO Secure Enclave deployment guide. Pairs with `mac-experience-d-platform-sso.json` and the bundled Company Portal install script. Exits non-zero on devices that have not yet completed PSSO registration; Intune retries daily until the device is in the registered state, at which point the script enables AutoFill and stays idempotent thereafter. Adapted from microsoft/shell-intune-samples (macOS/Config/Set Autofill Automatically after PSSO Registration). Fleet-wide; no Tier element.Expand

#!/bin/zsh
# macOS - Experience - D - PSSO AutoFill
#
# Verifies Platform SSO registration and enables the Company Portal AutoFill
# credential-provider extension via `pluginkit -e use -i`. This is the canonical
# workflow documented by Microsoft for using the Platform Credential as a
# passkey — Intune Settings Catalog has no MDM key to pre-approve the
# credential provider, so the toggle in System Settings -> General ->
# AutoFill & Passwords would otherwise need to be flipped manually by every
# user the first time they register PSSO.
#
# Pairs with `mac-experience-d-platform-sso.json` and the Company Portal
# install script. Fleet-wide; no Tier element.
#
# Source: adapted from microsoft/shell-intune-samples
#   macOS/Config/Set Autofill Automatically after PSSO Registration/Check-PSSO.zsh
# Runs as root (RunAsAccount=system); uses `launchctl asuser` + `sudo -u` to
# operate against the console user's per-user pluginkit database.
#
# Exit codes
#   0 = PSSO registered AND AutoFill enabled (or already enabled — idempotent)
#   1 = Pre-conditions not met (no user, PSSO not registered, Company Portal
#       missing, AutoFill extension not yet visible, or enable failed)
# A non-zero exit is expected on devices that have not yet completed PSSO
# registration — Intune retries daily per the manifest ExecutionFrequency.

logandmetadir="/Library/Logs/Microsoft/IntuneScripts/checkPSSO"
logfile="$logandmetadir/Check-PSSO.log"
verbose=false

# Create log directory if needed
if [[ ! -d "$logandmetadir" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$logandmetadir"
    if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: Failed to create log directory $logandmetadir"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Rotate log if larger than 1MB
if [[ -f "$logfile" ]] && (( $(stat -f%z "$logfile" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) > 1048576 )); then
    mv "$logfile" "${logfile}.old"
fi

# Start logging
exec > >(tee -a "$logfile") 2>&1

# Helper function to reduce repeated date calls
log() { echo "$(date -u "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") | $1"; }

log ""
log "========================================="
log "Starting Platform SSO (PSSO) Check"
log "========================================="

# 0. Check macOS version early - PSSO requires macOS 13+
macos_version=$(sw_vers -productVersion)
macos_major=${macos_version%%.*}
if (( macos_major < 13 )); then
    log "macOS $macos_version detected. Platform SSO requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later."
    exit 1
fi

if [[ "$verbose" == true ]]; then
    log "macOS version: $macos_version (Build $(sw_vers -buildVersion))"
    log "Hardware: $(sysctl -n hw.model)"
    log "Script running as: $(whoami) (UID $(id -u))"
fi

# 1. Wait for Dock (indicates user session is ready)
DOCK_WAIT=0
DOCK_MAX_WAIT=600
DOCK_LOG_INTERVAL=30
while ! pgrep -x "Dock" &>/dev/null; do
    if (( DOCK_WAIT >= DOCK_MAX_WAIT )); then
        log "Timed out waiting for Dock after ${DOCK_MAX_WAIT}s. No user session available."
        exit 1
    fi
    # Only log every DOCK_LOG_INTERVAL seconds to reduce noise
    if (( DOCK_WAIT % DOCK_LOG_INTERVAL == 0 )); then
        log "Waiting for Dock... (${DOCK_WAIT}s)"
    fi
    sleep 5
    (( DOCK_WAIT += 5 ))
done

# 2. Get the current console user and UID
currentUser=$(scutil <<< "show State:/Users/ConsoleUser" | awk '/Name :/ { print $3 }')
if [[ -z "$currentUser" || "$currentUser" == "loginwindow" ]]; then
    log "No user currently logged in."
    exit 1
fi
currentUID=$(id -u "$currentUser" 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -z "$currentUID" ]]; then
    log "Failed to resolve UID for user: $currentUser"
    exit 1
fi
log "Running as user: $currentUser (UID $currentUID)"

# 3. Check if app-sso command exists
if ! command -v app-sso &>/dev/null; then
    log "app-sso command not found. Platform SSO requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later."
    exit 1
fi

# 4. Check Platform SSO status
log "Checking Platform SSO registration status..."
psso_output=$(launchctl asuser "$currentUID" sudo -u "$currentUser" app-sso platform -s 2>&1)
psso_rc=$?
if [[ "$verbose" == true ]]; then
    log "app-sso exit code: $psso_rc"
    log "app-sso output:"
    echo "$psso_output" | while IFS= read -r line; do
        log "  $line"
    done
fi

if [[ $psso_rc -ne 0 ]]; then
    log "Platform SSO registration: NOT CONFIGURED"
    exit 1
fi

# 5. Parse registration state using zsh pattern matching (avoids spawning grep)
if [[ "$psso_output" == *'"registrationCompleted" : true'* ]]; then
    log "Platform SSO registration: COMPLETE"
else
    log "Platform SSO registration: NOT COMPLETE"
    exit 1
fi

# 6. Check Company Portal installation
cp_app_path="/Applications/Company Portal.app"
autofill_bundle="$cp_app_path/Contents/PlugIns/AutofillExtensionMacOS.appex"

if [[ ! -d "$cp_app_path" ]]; then
    log "ERROR: Company Portal NOT found at $cp_app_path. Cannot enable AutoFill."
    exit 1
fi

if [[ "$verbose" == true ]]; then
    cp_version=$(/usr/bin/defaults read "$cp_app_path/Contents/Info.plist" CFBundleShortVersionString 2>/dev/null)
    log "Company Portal installed: $cp_app_path (version $cp_version)"
fi

# Check if the AutoFill extension bundle exists on disk - fail early if missing
if [[ ! -d "$autofill_bundle" ]]; then
    log "ERROR: AutoFill extension bundle NOT found at $autofill_bundle. Company Portal may need updating."
    exit 1
fi

if [[ "$verbose" == true ]]; then
    log "AutoFill extension bundle found on disk: $autofill_bundle"
    log "All registered credential provider extensions:"
    launchctl asuser "$currentUID" sudo -u "$currentUser" pluginkit -m -v 2>/dev/null | grep -i "autofill\|credential\|company" | while IFS= read -r line; do
        log "  $line"
    done
fi

# 7. Wait for Company Portal AutoFill extension to be registered
log "Checking AutoFill from Company Portal..."
autofill_id="com.microsoft.CompanyPortalMac.Mac-Autofill-Extension"
AUTOFILL_WAIT=0
AUTOFILL_MAX_WAIT=300
AUTOFILL_LOG_INTERVAL=30
autofill_found=false
while [[ "$autofill_found" == false ]]; do
    # Check if extension is registered (filter by identifier directly)
    if launchctl asuser "$currentUID" sudo -u "$currentUser" pluginkit -m -i "$autofill_id" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$autofill_id"; then
        autofill_found=true
        break
    fi
    if (( AUTOFILL_WAIT >= AUTOFILL_MAX_WAIT )); then
        log "AutoFill from Company Portal: NOT FOUND (timed out after ${AUTOFILL_MAX_WAIT}s)"
        exit 1
    fi
    # Only log every AUTOFILL_LOG_INTERVAL seconds
    if (( AUTOFILL_WAIT % AUTOFILL_LOG_INTERVAL == 0 )); then
        log "Waiting for AutoFill extension to register... (${AUTOFILL_WAIT}s)"
    fi
    sleep 10
    (( AUTOFILL_WAIT += 10 ))
done

# 8. Enable the AutoFill extension via pluginkit with retry
log "Enabling AutoFill from Company Portal..."
enable_attempts=0
enable_max=3
enable_success=false

while (( enable_attempts < enable_max )); do
    (( enable_attempts++ ))
    launchctl asuser "$currentUID" sudo -u "$currentUser" pluginkit -e use -i "$autofill_id" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 2

    # Verify it is actually ENABLED by reading the state flag (col 1):
    #   +  enabled   -  disabled   (blank)  no explicit state
    # head -1 drops the trailing "(1 plug-in)" summary line.
    pk_state=$(launchctl asuser "$currentUID" sudo -u "$currentUser" \
        pluginkit -m -v -i "$autofill_id" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -c1)

    if [[ "$pk_state" == "+" ]]; then
        enable_success=true
        break
    fi
    log "Enable attempt $enable_attempts/$enable_max — state '${pk_state:-unset}', retrying..."
    sleep 3
done

if [[ "$enable_success" == true ]]; then
    log "AutoFill from Company Portal: ENABLED"
    exit 0
else
    log "AutoFill from Company Portal: FAILED TO ENABLE after $enable_max attempts (last state: ${pk_state:-unset})"
    exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env zsh
###############################################################################
# SYNOPSIS
# Script to seed a starting Dock for the signed-in user via Intune Platform
# Scripts.
#
# DESCRIPTION
# Seeds a starting Dock for the signed-in user once, then never touches it
# again. The user owns their Dock from that point on: reorder, add, or delete
# any of these apps and the change sticks.
#
# Apps that have not finished installing are seeded anyway. The Dock keeps
# the entry, shows a "?" placeholder, and resolves it itself once the app
# lands (at the next Dock relaunch or login). Runs as the signed-in user.
#
# Standalone shell script deployed via:
# Intune > Devices > macOS > Shell scripts
# (single script, no separate detection/remediation pair - runs once per assignment).
#
# Actions are logged locally in:
# /Library/Logs/IntuneLogs/
#
# CREDITS
# Written by: Faisal Rustveld
#
# COMPANY
# ITQ
#
# NOTES
# Name    : PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-Seed-Dock-<VERSION>.zsh
#
# Intune Platform Script.
# Exits with code 0 on success.
# Exits with any non-zero code on failure (shown as an error in Intune).
#
# Naming convention:
#     <Prefix>-ITQ-<Assignment>-<Platform>-<Scope>-<Action><Target>-<Major.Minor.Patch>.sh
#
#     Prefix     : PS = PowerShell/Shell Script
#     Assignment : da = Device Assignment, ua = User Assignment
#     Platform   : mac = macOS
#     Scope      : e.g. all, or a specific device/user group scope
#
# Example:
# PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-Seed-Dock-1.0.0.zsh
#
# Bump the version number (and this history) every time the logic changes.
#
# DETAILS
# Creation Date: 2026-08-14
#
# Version history:
#     1.0.0 - (2026-08-14) - Faisal Rustveld - Initial release, converted to
#                             the ITQ Platform Script template.
#
# EXECUTION (manual)
# chmod +x PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-Seed-Dock-1.0.0.zsh
# sudo ./PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-Seed-Dock-1.0.0.zsh
###############################################################################

# ============================
# CONFIGURATION (adjust per script)
# ============================

SCRIPT_NAME="PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-Seed-Dock-1.0.0"
LOG_FOLDER="/Library/Logs/IntuneLogs"
TIMESTAMP_DAILY=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d")
MAX_LOGS_TO_KEEP=5

# Starting Dock, left to right.
DOCK_APPS=(
    "/Applications/Company Portal.app"
    "/Applications/Microsoft Edge.app"
    "/Applications/Microsoft Outlook.app"
    "/Applications/Microsoft Teams.app"
    "/Applications/Microsoft Excel.app"
    "/Applications/Microsoft Word.app"
    "/Applications/Microsoft PowerPoint.app"
    "/System/Applications/System Settings.app"
)

SENTINEL_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/macos-baseline"
SENTINEL_FILE="$SENTINEL_DIR/dock-seeded"

# --- Helper Functions ---

write_custom_log() {
    MESSAGE="$1"
    LOG_TYPE="${2:-Platform}"
    LOG_FILE="$LOG_FOLDER/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${LOG_TYPE}_${TIMESTAMP_DAILY}.log"

    mkdir -p "$LOG_FOLDER"
    printf '%s - %s\n' "$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S")" "$MESSAGE" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

remove_old_custom_logs() {
    mkdir -p "$LOG_FOLDER"

    find "$LOG_FOLDER" \
        -name "${SCRIPT_NAME}_Platform_*.log" \
        -type f \
        | sort \
        | head -n -"$MAX_LOGS_TO_KEEP" \
        | while IFS= read -r old_log; do
            rm -f "$old_log"
        done
}

# --- Initialize Logging ---

remove_old_custom_logs

write_custom_log " "
write_custom_log "=== START PLATFORM SCRIPT ==="

#########################################################################################
#                              Start of Platform Script                                 #
#########################################################################################

OUTPUT_MESSAGE="Script completed successfully"
LOG_MESSAGE="=== PLATFORM SCRIPT COMPLETE ==="
EXIT_CODE=0

# =========================================================
# REPLACE BELOW WITH YOUR OWN SCRIPT LOGIC
# Use write_custom_log to record each action/result.
# =========================================================

# 1. Already seeded — leave the user's Dock alone.
if [[ -f "$SENTINEL_FILE" ]]; then
    write_custom_log "Sentinel present at $SENTINEL_FILE — Dock already seeded; leaving the user's layout alone."
    OUTPUT_MESSAGE="Sentinel present — Dock already seeded; leaving the user's layout alone."
    EXIT_CODE=0
else
    # 2. Setup Assistant runs as _mbsetupuser (UID 248, HOME=/var/setup), whose
    # Dock is thrown away with the account. Real user accounts start at UID 501.
    # Not a failure — the next run seeds once a real user has signed in.
    if (( UID < 501 )); then
        write_custom_log "Running as $(/usr/bin/id -un) (UID $UID) — no real user account yet; nothing to seed."
        OUTPUT_MESSAGE="Running as $(/usr/bin/id -un) (UID $UID) — no real user account yet; nothing to seed."
        EXIT_CODE=0
    else
        # 3. Build the Dock tile plist entries.
        tiles=()
        for app in "${DOCK_APPS[@]}"; do
            if [[ -d "$app" ]]; then
                write_custom_log "App installed: $app"
            else
                write_custom_log "App not yet installed (will show as a placeholder): $app"
            fi
            tiles+=("<dict><key>tile-data</key><dict><key>file-data</key><dict><key>_CFURLString</key><string>${app}</string><key>_CFURLStringType</key><integer>0</integer></dict></dict><key>tile-type</key><string>file-tile</string></dict>")
        done

        # 4. Write the Dock, restart it, then record the seed so this never runs again.
        if /usr/bin/defaults write com.apple.dock persistent-apps -array "${tiles[@]}"; then
            /bin/sleep 1
            /usr/bin/killall Dock 2>/dev/null || true
            /bin/mkdir -p "$SENTINEL_DIR"
            /usr/bin/touch "$SENTINEL_FILE"
            write_custom_log "Seeded ${#tiles[@]} Dock tile(s); sentinel written to $SENTINEL_FILE."
            OUTPUT_MESSAGE="Seeded ${#tiles[@]} Dock tile(s); sentinel written to $SENTINEL_FILE."
            EXIT_CODE=0
        else
            write_custom_log "ERROR: defaults write failed — sentinel NOT written; will retry next run."
            OUTPUT_MESSAGE="defaults write failed — sentinel NOT written; will retry next run."
            LOG_MESSAGE="=== PLATFORM SCRIPT FAILED ==="
            EXIT_CODE=1
        fi
    fi
fi

# =========================================================
# END OF SCRIPT LOGIC
# =========================================================

#########################################################################################
#                               End of Platform Script                                  #
#########################################################################################

write_custom_log "$LOG_MESSAGE"

echo "$OUTPUT_MESSAGE"

exit "$EXIT_CODE"

#!/usr/bin/env zsh
# macOS - Experience - D - Battery Percentage
#
# Enables "Show Percentage" on the menu-bar battery icon for the signed-in user.
# Convenience default only — not a security control.
#
# Runs once via a sentinel file so a user who later hides the percentage in
# System Settings > Control Center keeps that choice. IMPORTANT: the sentinel is
# written ONLY AFTER the value is verified applied — so a run that fails to apply
# retries next cycle instead of locking in a broken state. (Original bug: it wrote
# the sentinel unconditionally, and `set -e` could abort before the write, leaving
# the setting neither applied nor retried.)
#
# Runs as the signed-in user (Intune manifest <RunAsAccount>user</RunAsAccount>).
# ponytail: deliberately NO `set -e` — each step is handled explicitly so the
# verify read still runs even if killall/defaults return non-zero.

set -u

SENTINEL_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/macos-baseline"
SENTINEL_FILE="$SENTINEL_DIR/battery-percentage-set"
DOMAIN="com.apple.controlcenter"
KEY="BatteryShowPercentage"

# Respect a prior successful seed (user may since have hidden it — leave it alone).
if [[ -f "$SENTINEL_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Sentinel present — already seeded; leaving the user's choice intact."
    exit 0
fi

# No-op on Macs without a battery (desktops).
if ! /usr/bin/pmset -g batt 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -q "InternalBattery"; then
    echo "No internal battery detected — nothing to do."
    exit 0
fi

# On Big Sur+ the battery % lives in the ByHost (currentHost) controlcenter domain,
# so -currentHost is required (verified on macOS 26 Tahoe).
#
# Gate the sentinel on the WRITE's exit status, NOT a read-back. In the Intune
# user-context runner, `defaults read` right after the write often returns empty
# (cfprefsd hasn't surfaced the fresh write) even though the write persisted and the
# % shows on-device — a read-back verify produced false "Failed" + endless retries.
# `defaults write` returning 0 is the reliable signal that the value was set.
if /usr/bin/defaults -currentHost write "$DOMAIN" "$KEY" -bool true; then
    /bin/sleep 1
    /usr/bin/killall ControlCenter 2>/dev/null || true
    /bin/mkdir -p "$SENTINEL_DIR"
    /usr/bin/touch "$SENTINEL_FILE"
    echo "Battery percentage enabled; sentinel written to $SENTINEL_FILE."
    exit 0
fi

echo "defaults write failed (exit $?) — sentinel NOT written; will retry next run." >&2
exit 1

#!/usr/bin/env zsh

# macOS - Security - D - Sudo Logging
#
# Restores sudo audit logging on macOS 15 Sequoia and macOS 26 Tahoe.
# Apple shipped /etc/sudoers with `Defaults !log_allowed` starting in
# macOS Sequoia (Oct 2024), which silently disabled unified-log capture
# of successful sudo invocations. Without intervention, only failed
# sudo attempts are logged — there is no audit trail for what
# privileged commands were actually executed.
#
# This script:
#   1. Writes `Defaults log_allowed` to
#      /etc/sudoers.d/macos-baseline-logging.
#   2. Comments out any `Defaults !log_allowed` lines in /etc/sudoers
#      and /etc/sudoers.d/* so Apple's default cannot override ours.
#
# After deployment, successful sudo events appear in the unified log
# under subsystem com.apple.sudo. Query with:
#   log show --predicate 'subsystem == "com.apple.sudo"' --last 1d
#
# CIS macOS 26 Tahoe Benchmark Level 1 — 5.12 Ensure Logging Is
# Enabled for Sudo. DISA STIG V-268451.
#
# Idempotent: writes only when needed, validates both /etc/sudoers
# and our additive file with visudo -cf before exit.

set -eu

SUDOERS_DIR="/etc/sudoers.d"
OUR_FILE="${SUDOERS_DIR}/macos-baseline-logging"
EXPECTED_LINE="Defaults log_allowed"

# Step 1: write our sudoers.d additive.
if [[ ! -d "${SUDOERS_DIR}" ]]; then
    /bin/mkdir -p "${SUDOERS_DIR}"
fi
/usr/sbin/chown -R root:wheel "${SUDOERS_DIR}"
/bin/chmod 750 "${SUDOERS_DIR}"

if [[ ! -f "${OUR_FILE}" ]] || ! /usr/bin/grep -qxF "${EXPECTED_LINE}" "${OUR_FILE}"; then
    /bin/echo "${EXPECTED_LINE}" > "${OUR_FILE}"
fi
/usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "${OUR_FILE}"
/bin/chmod 440 "${OUR_FILE}"

# Step 2: comment out any `Defaults !log_allowed` in /etc/sudoers and
# /etc/sudoers.d/*. Pattern is tight — matches only the exact line
# Apple ships, not any user-authored variation.
/usr/bin/find /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d -type f \
    -exec /usr/bin/sed -i '' -E '/^Defaults[[:blank:]]+\!log_allowed[[:blank:]]*$/s|^|# |' {} \;

# Step 3: validate both files with visudo before exit.
if ! /usr/sbin/visudo -cf "${OUR_FILE}" >/dev/null; then
    /bin/echo "ERROR: visudo rejected ${OUR_FILE}" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! /usr/sbin/visudo -cf /etc/sudoers >/dev/null; then
    /bin/echo "ERROR: visudo rejected /etc/sudoers after edit" >&2
    exit 1
fi

/bin/echo "Sudo logging restored (Defaults log_allowed active, Apple's !log_allowed commented out)."
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env zsh

# macOS - Security - D - Sudo Timeout
#
# Forces a zero-second sudo credential cache: every sudo invocation
# requires fresh authentication, with no grace window after the first
# password entry. macOS default is 5 minutes.
#
# Writes the policy to /etc/sudoers.d/macos-baseline-timeout rather
# than the main /etc/sudoers — a syntax error in sudoers.d is ignored
# by sudo rather than locking the system out.
#
# CIS macOS Benchmark Level 1 — 5.4 Ensure the Sudo Timeout Period
# Is Set to Zero.
#
# Idempotent: only writes when the expected line is not already present.

set -eu

SUDOERS_DIR="/etc/sudoers.d"
SUDOERS_FILE="${SUDOERS_DIR}/macos-baseline-timeout"
EXPECTED_LINE="Defaults timestamp_timeout=0"

if [[ ! -d "${SUDOERS_DIR}" ]]; then
    /bin/mkdir -p "${SUDOERS_DIR}"
fi
/usr/sbin/chown -R root:wheel "${SUDOERS_DIR}"
/bin/chmod 750 "${SUDOERS_DIR}"

if [[ ! -f "${SUDOERS_FILE}" ]] || ! /usr/bin/grep -qxF "${EXPECTED_LINE}" "${SUDOERS_FILE}"; then
    /bin/echo "${EXPECTED_LINE}" > "${SUDOERS_FILE}"
fi

/usr/sbin/chown root:wheel "${SUDOERS_FILE}"
/bin/chmod 440 "${SUDOERS_FILE}"

# Validate syntax. visudo -c returns non-zero on parse error; leave the
# file in place for forensic inspection rather than silently deleting it.
if ! /usr/sbin/visudo -cf "${SUDOERS_FILE}" >/dev/null; then
    /bin/echo "ERROR: visudo rejected ${SUDOERS_FILE}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

/bin/echo "Sudo timeout enforced (timestamp_timeout=0)."
exit 0

#!/bin/sh

###############################################################################
# SYNOPSIS
# Script to rename a macOS device to the naming convention IMAA-<SerialNumber>
# via Intune Platform Scripts.
#
# DESCRIPTION
# Retrieves the macOS serial number and renames the ComputerName, HostName
# and LocalHostName to the naming convention IMAA-<SerialNumber>.
#
# Standalone script deployed via:
# Intune > Devices > macOS > Shell scripts
# (single script, no separate detection/remediation pair - runs once per assignment).
#
# Actions are logged locally in:
# /Library/Logs/IntuneLogs/
#
# CREDITS
# Written by: Faisal Rustveld
#
# COMPANY
# ITQ
#
# NOTES
# Name    : PS-ITQ-<da|ua>-mac-all-DeviceRename-<VERSION>.sh
#
# Intune Platform Script.
# Exits with code 0 on success.
# Exits with any non-zero code on failure (shown as an error in Intune).
#
# Naming convention:
#     <Prefix>-ITQ-<Assignment>-<Platform>-<Scope>-<Action><Target>-<Major.Minor.Patch>.sh
#
#     Prefix     : PS = Platform Script
#     Assignment : da = Device Assignment, ua = User Assignment
#     Platform   : mac = macOS
#     Scope      : e.g. all, or a specific device/user group scope
#
# Example:
# PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-DeviceRename-1.0.0.sh
#
# Bump the version number (and this history) every time the logic changes.
#
# DETAILS
# Creation Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
#
# Version history:
#     1.0.0 - (<YYYY-MM-DD>) - <YOUR NAME> - Initial release
#
# EXECUTION (manual)
# chmod +x PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-DeviceRename-1.0.0.sh
# sudo ./PS-ITQ-da-mac-all-DeviceRename-1.0.0.sh
###############################################################################

# ============================
# CONFIGURATION (adjust per script)
# ============================

SCRIPT_NAME="DeviceRename"
LOG_FOLDER="/Library/Logs/IntuneLogs"
TIMESTAMP_DAILY=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d")
MAX_LOGS_TO_KEEP=5

# --- Helper Functions ---

write_custom_log() {

    MESSAGE="$1"
    LOG_TYPE="${2:-Platform}"

    mkdir -p "$LOG_FOLDER"

    echo "$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S") - $MESSAGE" >> \
    "$LOG_FOLDER/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${LOG_TYPE}_${TIMESTAMP_DAILY}.log"

}

remove_old_custom_logs() {

    LOG_LIST=$(find "$LOG_FOLDER" -name "${SCRIPT_NAME}_Platform_*.log" -type f | sort)
    LOG_COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$LOG_LIST" | grep -c .)

    if [ "$LOG_COUNT" -gt "$MAX_LOGS_TO_KEEP" ]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$LOG_LIST" \
            | head -n "$((LOG_COUNT - MAX_LOGS_TO_KEEP))" \
            | xargs -r rm -f
    fi

}

# --- Initialize Logging ---

remove_old_custom_logs

write_custom_log " "
write_custom_log "=== START PLATFORM SCRIPT ==="

#########################################################################################
#                              Start of Platform Script                                 #
#########################################################################################

OUTPUT_MESSAGE="Script completed successfully"
LOG_MESSAGE="=== PLATFORM SCRIPT COMPLETE ==="
EXIT_CODE=0

SERIAL_NUMBER=$(ioreg -l | awk -F'"' '/IOPlatformSerialNumber/ {print $4}')
NEW_NAME="IMAA-$SERIAL_NUMBER"

write_custom_log "Current ComputerName : $(scutil --get ComputerName 2>/dev/null)"
write_custom_log "Current HostName     : $(scutil --get HostName 2>/dev/null)"
write_custom_log "Current LocalHostName: $(scutil --get LocalHostName 2>/dev/null)"
write_custom_log "Serial Number        : $SERIAL_NUMBER"
write_custom_log "New Device Name      : $NEW_NAME"

if scutil --set ComputerName "$NEW_NAME" &&
   scutil --set HostName "$NEW_NAME" &&
   scutil --set LocalHostName "$NEW_NAME"
then

    write_custom_log "Device renamed successfully."

else

    OUTPUT_MESSAGE="Script failed while renaming device."
    LOG_MESSAGE="SCRIPT FAILED: Unable to rename device."
    EXIT_CODE=1

fi

#########################################################################################
#                               End of Platform Script                                  #
#########################################################################################

write_custom_log "$LOG_MESSAGE"

echo "$OUTPUT_MESSAGE"

exit $EXIT_CODE
